paper.title: Measuring Cross-Task Behavioral Consistency in Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: Agent evaluation relies almost entirely on outcome metrics such as success rate, which capture whether an agent succeeds but not how consistently it behaves. We argue that behavioral consistency across tasks is a distinct and measurable property, and we introduce the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) to quantify it. BCM trains a model to predict task success from behavioral features of agent execution traces, derives a per-trajectory feature-attribution vector, and measures the mean pairwise s

summary.core_problem: Agent评估几乎完全依赖成功率等结果指标，无法衡量agent在不同任务间行为的一致性程度。
summary.importance: 提出行为一致性指标BCM，并发现跨任务一致性与任务内一致性是可分离的两个维度，可能出现背离，为agent可靠性评估提供新维度。
summary.technical_approach: 训练模型从agent执行轨迹的行为特征预测任务成功，推导每条轨迹的特征归因向量，测量同一agent系统内向量的平均成对相似度作为BCM。
summary.experiments: 约9000条轨迹，6个语言模型agent，软件工程任务；发现部分系统局部可复现（同任务重复行为相似）但全局碎片化（跨任务无稳定策略），另一部分在两个尺度上都一致。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent evaluation relies almost entirely on outcome metrics such as success rate, which cannot measure how consistently an agent behaves across tasks.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Behavioral Consistency Metric (BCM) and finds that cross-task and within-task consistency are distinct, potentially divergent axes, adding a new dimension to agent reliability evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a model to predict task success from behavioral features of execution traces, derives a per-trajectory feature-attribution vector, and measures mean pairwise similarity of these vectors within an agent system as BCM.
summary_en.experiments: Roughly 9,000 trajectories from six LLM agents on software engineering tasks; finds some systems are locally reproducible (similar behavior on repeated attempts at one task) yet globally fragmented (no stable strategy across tasks), while others are consistent at both scales.

recommendation.zh: 任务内与跨任务一致性可分离的概念有新意，但agent评估距pretrain较远；了解BCM定义和核心发现即可。
recommendation.en: The within-task vs. cross-task consistency distinction is conceptually novel, but agent evaluation is distant from pretraining; understand the BCM definition and key finding only.

paper.title: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model
paper.abstract: AI coding agents are commonly evaluated as models but deployed as systems. Their reliability depends not only on model capability, but on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation. This monograph examines those boundaries and develops a framework for evaluating and operating coding agents reliably. It synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case record

summary.core_problem: 编码 agent 通常被当作模型来评测，但实际以系统形式部署；如何评测和运维其端到端可靠性。
summary.importance: 提出系统层评测与运维视角，综合大量学术与实践证据，指出许多看似模型失败其实来自 harness、执行状态、检索、权限或验证环节。
summary.technical_approach: 通过结构化多声部综述、更新审计、软件工程覆盖分析和分布式系统证据综合，将评测与运维建模为依赖链，覆盖任务构造、执行环境、检索、状态管理、验证和可观测性等层。
summary.experiments: 综合 164 篇学术工作、100 条实践记录、29 个 benchmark 和 17 个作者系统案例；没有训练新模型，主要结论是单层改进常无法传递到端到端结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Coding agents are evaluated as models but deployed as systems; how should their end-to-end reliability be evaluated and operated?
summary_en.importance: It contributes a system-level evaluation and operations perspective, synthesizing broad evidence that many apparent model failures originate in the harness, execution state, retrieval, permissions, or verification layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a structured multivocal review, update audits, software-engineering coverage analysis, and distributed-systems evidence synthesis to model evaluation and operation as a dependency chain across task construction, execution environments, retrieval, state management, verification, and observability.
summary_en.experiments: Synthesizes 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmarks, and 17 author-system case studies; no new model is trained, and the main finding is that improvements at one layer often do not propagate to end-to-end outcomes.

recommendation.zh: 把 coding agent 当分布式系统做依赖链分析，对设计 SWE 评测有参考；但这是综述不是新方法，看失败分类即可。
recommendation.en: The dependency-chain view of coding agents is useful for designing SWE evaluations, but this is a synthesis rather than a new method—read the failure taxonomy and skip the bulk.

paper.title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/f

summary.core_problem: 现有仓库级 coding agent benchmark 主要看最终补丁是否通过测试，无法解释 agent 在需求澄清、实现规划、代码生成链条中哪里偏离了正确路径。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测资产贡献。SWE-RPG 把最终可执行补丁评测和中间过程的 ground-truth reference 结合起来，试图把 coding agent 评测从单一 pass/fail 推向可诊断的过程评测。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了包含三类信号的仓库级 benchmark：最终 patch 的可执行测试结果、需求澄清的标注参考、实现规划的标注参考。核心不是提出新的 coding agent，而是用经过验证的中间 GT 对完整 agent trajectory 做回溯诊断，分析失败来自需求理解、计划制定还是代码落地。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、样本量和提升数字。实验重点应是用多个 coding agent 在 SWE-RPG 上运行，并展示中间 GT 能提供比最终测试通过率更细的错误归因。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level coding-agent benchmarks usually score only whether the final patch passes tests, leaving no clean way to locate failures in requirement clarification, planning, or code generation.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution. SWE-RPG augments executable patch evaluation with validated intermediate ground truths, moving coding-agent evaluation from a binary outcome toward trajectory-level diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark provides ground-truth references for requirement clarification and implementation planning, in addition to final patch execution. The main contribution is not a new agent method, but a GT-aligned retrospective analysis protocol for full coding-agent trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, dataset scale, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation compares multiple coding agents and shows that intermediate GTs expose failure modes hidden by final pass/fail scores.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和诊断协议；对预训练没直接动作，但能校准 coding agent eval 是否只在测补丁运气。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and diagnosis protocol; it will not change pretraining, but it helps calibrate whether coding-agent evals are just testing patch luck.

paper.title: FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents
paper.abstract: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stro

summary.core_problem: 解决代码 Agent 的 RFT 只保留成功轨迹、丢弃失败轨迹，导致难例训练信号浪费的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码 Agent 后训练方法。它不直接改预训练，但对 verifiable tasks 上的训练信号利用、失败样本再加工和 Agentic self-improvement 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FailForge：对失败实例，先由 Agent 根据错误反馈和执行 trace 诊断失败原因；再把诊断压缩成简洁、可执行的 skill；随后将 skill 注入上下文进行第二次尝试。只有在 skill guidance 下转为成功的轨迹才进入微调，从而把原本被 RFT 丢弃的失败样本转成训练数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明面向可验证的软件工程任务，并与标准 rejection sampling fine-tuning 对比；具体基座模型、任务集、通过率提升和消融结果未在给定摘要中披露，需要看实验部分判断是否只是数据再标注收益。

summary_en.core_problem: FailForge tackles the waste of hard failure trajectories in code-agent RFT, where standard training keeps only rollouts that pass tests and discards the rest.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for code agents. It does not change pretraining directly, but it is relevant to training-signal extraction from verifiable tasks, failure reuse, and agentic self-improvement loops.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each failed instance, an agent diagnoses the failure from error feedback and execution traces, distills the diagnosis into a concise actionable skill, injects that skill into the agent context, and retries the task. Trajectories that succeed under the skill-guided retry are then used for fine-tuning, converting discarded failures into usable supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes experiments on verifiable software-engineering tasks against standard rejection sampling fine-tuning. It does not expose the model sizes, datasets, pass-rate gains, or ablations in the provided text, so the empirical strength depends on the full experimental section.

recommendation.zh: 读训练数据构造和失败诊断消融；若收益来自 hard-case 转正，而非更长上下文提示，值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the data-construction and failure-diagnosis ablations; if gains come from hard-case conversion rather than longer prompting, it is worth reproducing.

paper.title: Characterizing the Quality Profile of AI-Generated C++ in Production
paper.abstract: The widespread integration of AI coding assistants offers undeniable boosts to engineering velocity. Yet, recent studies point to a growing trade-off, revealing persistent challenges with code quality and maintainability. Industry leaders, including frontier AI labs, echo these concerns. As large language models are increasingly relied upon to author production code, understanding their impact on shipped software quality has become a critical priority. However, assessing these effects in industr

summary.core_problem: 缺乏大规模工业级实证数据来量化AI生成的C++代码对生产环境软件质量和可维护性的实际影响。
summary.importance: 数据贡献+实证分析，基于服务数十亿用户的大型企业的生产代码可观测性体系，首次大规模分析AI生成C++代码的生产质量特征。
summary.technical_approach: 利用企业完善的代码部署全链路可观测性能力，对每一行生产代码的来源、变更历史和质量指标进行关联分析，对比AI生成与人工编写代码的质量差异。
summary.experiments: 在全球数十亿用户使用的大型企业产品中开展大规模实证研究，覆盖生产环境全量C++代码的质量追踪（摘要未完整给出具体量化结果）。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自Google，包含知名系统与ML研究者Milad Hashemi和Parthasarathy Ranganathan。

summary_en.core_problem: There is a lack of large-scale industrial empirical data to quantify the actual impact of AI-generated C++ code on software quality and maintainability in production environments.
summary_en.importance: Data contribution + empirical analysis; first large-scale analysis of production quality profiles of AI-generated C++ code, based on the production code observability system of a large enterprise serving billions of users.
summary_en.technical_approach: Leverages the enterprise's comprehensive full-stack observability for code deployment to correlate the source, change history, and quality metrics of every line of production code, comparing quality differences between AI-generated and human-written code.
summary_en.experiments: Conducts large-scale empirical research on enterprise products used by billions of users worldwide, covering quality tracking of all C++ code in production (specific quantitative results are not fully provided in the abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Author team is from Google, including well-known systems and ML researchers Milad Hashemi and Parthasarathy Ranganathan.

recommendation.zh: Google的工业级AI生成C++代码质量实证研究，做代码LLM的可看结论了解实际痛点，通用预训练无需阅读。
recommendation.en: Google's industrial-scale empirical study of AI-generated C++ code quality; only worth checking conclusions if you work on code LLMs, no need for general pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Learning Globally Reusable Skills for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Automated skill evolution enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to continuously improve without expensive retraining. However, existing approaches typically treat skill evolution as a sequence of local updates, overlooking relationships among skills and often producing overfitted skill updates that fail to generalize across tasks. We propose GSE, a globalized skill evolution framework that jointly optimizes skill compatibility and skill generalization. To preserve consistency across the skil

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 的技能库在持续演化时容易局部过拟合、跨任务复用能力弱的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 的系统方法改进。它关注不重新训练基座模型的能力积累路径，对“外部技能库如何补足参数更新”有一定参考价值，但离预训练方法论较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GSE，全局化技能演化框架。核心是维护 Skill Relation Graph 显式建模技能间关系，并用聚类式技能合并把局部更新抽象成更通用的能力；同时加入 replay-driven verification，检查新技能是否带来过拟合或行为回退。
summary.experiments: 在两个软件工程任务上评估：bug-revealing test generation 和 false-positive bug report filtering。摘要只说明与现有 coding agent 方法比较并取得更好表现，未给出完整提升幅度、模型规模或训练数据细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the problem that coding-agent skill evolution often overfits to local task updates and fails to produce reusable skills across tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system-level method for coding agents. It is relevant as a non-parametric capability accumulation mechanism, but it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GSE globalizes skill evolution by maintaining a Skill Relation Graph to model compatibility among skills, consolidating clustered local updates into reusable skills, and using replay-driven verification to detect overfitting and behavioral regressions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers two software-engineering tasks: bug-revealing test generation and false-positive bug report filtering. The abstract reports gains over existing coding-agent approaches, but does not expose model sizes, training data, or exact improvement numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为 skill-memory 方向的工程信号可看摘要；预训练研究员只需记住“局部技能更新会过拟合”这个失败模式。
recommendation.en: Useful as an engineering signal for skill-memory systems; for pretraining, the only durable lesson is that local skill updates overfit easily.

paper.title: Distilling Reasoning Traces into Advisory Prompts for Software Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: Language models are widely used for generating and otherwise processing code (e.g., identifying code hallucinations, possible inputs, or predicting outputs); however, LLMs can make mistakes, which can be serious. One key issue is that models are trained on (still) largely human-written, and thus imperfect, code; it's not easy to find sufficiently large code corpora that are entirely free of bugs. Thus, other inference-time ways of reducing LLM errors, without additional training, are desirable.

summary.core_problem: 研究能否把 reasoning mode 产生的错误分析和反思压缩成 advisory prompts，从而在软件工程任务上减少错误而不总是支付推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献是代码任务中的 inference-time prompting 策略，试图把昂贵 reasoning traces 转化为可复用的轻量提示。它对后训练和推理时计算分配有轻微信号，但不是预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法模拟人类学习编程错误的过程：先识别 LLM 在代码相关任务中的错误，再使用 reasoning/thinking mode 反思导致错误的认知失误，抽取通用规则或 lesson，最后把这些规则作为 advisory prompts 注入后续非 reasoning 推理。整体更像提示蒸馏，而不是参数蒸馏或 SFT。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到面向代码生成、代码幻觉识别、输入推断、输出预测等软件工程任务，目标是在不开启完整 reasoning 的情况下改善表现；未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 数值、成本下降比例或统计显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether reasoning-mode traces can be compressed into advisory prompts that reduce errors on software-engineering tasks without always paying the cost of reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time prompting strategy for code tasks. It turns expensive reasoning traces into reusable lightweight guidance. It is mildly relevant to post-training and test-time compute allocation, but it is not a pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method mimics how programming students learn from mistakes: identify model errors, use reasoning mode to reflect on the cognitive lapses behind them, infer general rules or lessons, and inject those lessons as advisory prompts during later non-reasoning inference. This is closer to prompt distillation than parameter distillation or SFT.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract discusses software-engineering tasks such as code generation, code-hallucination identification, input inference, and output prediction. It aims to improve performance without full reasoning mode, but does not provide model names, dataset sizes, baseline numbers, cost reductions, or significance tests in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 reasoning trace 压缩成提示的弱信号保留；若正文没有成本-质量曲线，就不值得细读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a weak signal on compressing reasoning traces into prompts; without a cost-quality curve, it is not worth a close read.

paper.title: An Empirical Study of Coordination Mode as the First-Class Citizen in From-Scratch Multi-Agent Coding
paper.abstract: Multi-agent vibe coding promises to accelerate software development, yet existing benchmarks rely on synthetic environments that ignore practical time and monetary costs, conflate reasoning with communication, and reward only superficial completion. We introduce multi-agent from-scratch evaluation benchmark, MSEval, evaluating multi-agent coding on real-world tasks. Grounded in 10 authentic, full-stack projects across 10 domains, MSEval scores performance using hierarchical requirements and dete

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体编码评测要么基于合成环境，要么固定单一协作模式，无法定量衡量在从零搭建真实软件项目时，协作拓扑、迭代反馈和成本开销对交付质量的实际影响。
summary.importance: 属于 multi-agent coding 的评测基础设施工作，对基座研究的直接启发有限，但在评测协议上提供了两个可迁移的想法：把协作模式作为一等自变量、把 wall-clock 与 token 成本作为与功能分并列的指标。对做长链路 agent post-training 或用代码/工程任务评估模型能力的研究者有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MSEval，包含 10 个真实 full-stack 项目、10 种协作拓扑（feature squad、layer specialist、pipeline handoff、swarming、rotation、PM oversight、QA-first、PR review、adversarial testing、competitive teams），配套运行时 LegoGent 支持有界同步、显式消息传递、CI/CD 部署和行为完成检查，以及自动 grader TAgent 对部署后的 UI/API/code 面进行探查，给出带权反馈，最多支持三轮迭代 refinement。评测同时记录功能分、延迟、token 使用量（含 prefix cache），用于刻画速度–成本–质量三者的权衡。
summary.experiments: 共构造 10 个项目 × 10 种协作模式 = 100 个 case 的评测网格。论文主要给出 benchmark 设计和框架性实证结论：协作拓扑、模型能力与项目领域共同决定 speed–cost–quality trade-off；不同模式并非单调优劣，存在明显的 domain–topology 交互。具体各模式相对提升数字在提供的全文片段中未展开。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看 Introduction 中与 SWE-bench、CloudDevBench、TheAgentCompany 的定位对比表，以及协作模式定义、指标设计（token cost / latency / iterative feedback）部分。方法实现细节（LegoGent 同步机制、TAgent 探查策略）可快速浏览。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-agent coding benchmarks either rely on synthetic environments or fix a single collaboration mode, making it impossible to quantitatively measure how coordination topology, iterative feedback, and cost affect delivery quality when building real software projects from scratch.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-infrastructure paper for multi-agent coding, with limited direct implications for base-model pretraining. Two ideas are transferable, however: treating coordination mode as a first-class independent variable, and reporting wall-clock latency and token cost alongside functional scores. It is relevant to researchers working on long-horizon agent post-training or using software-engineering tasks to evaluate model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MSEval, which consists of 10 realistic full-stack projects, 10 collaboration topologies (feature squads, layer specialists, pipeline handoff, swarming, rotation, PM oversight, QA-first, PR-style review, adversarial testing, competitive teams), a runtime called LegoGent that supports bounded synchronization, explicit peer messaging, CI/CD deployment, and behavioral completion checks, plus an automated grader TAgent that probes deployed UI/API/code surfaces and returns weighted feedback for up to three refinement rounds. Functional score, wall-clock latency, and token usage (including prefix-cache savings) are logged jointly to characterize the speed–cost–quality trade-off.
summary_en.experiments: A 10 × 10 evaluation grid is constructed, covering 100 cases across projects and collaboration modes. The paper reports benchmark design and framework-level empirical findings: topology, model capability, and project domain jointly determine the speed–cost–quality trade-off, and no single mode dominates uniformly; domain–topology interactions are substantial. Concrete per-mode performance numbers are not available in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the positioning table in the introduction (comparison with SWE-bench, CloudDevBench, TheAgentCompany), the definitions of collaboration modes, and the metric design (token cost, latency, iterative feedback). Implementation details of LegoGent synchronization and TAgent probing can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多智能体编码评测的新范式，核心看§3协作拓扑设计与§5拓扑vs模型能力的对比结果，对RL后训练的多智能体数据构造有参考。
recommendation.en: New paradigm for multi-agent coding evaluation; focus on §3 topology design and §5 topology-vs-model-capability comparison, useful for multi-agent RL post-training data construction.

paper.title: SWE-NFI: Studying and Benchmarking Coding Agents for Non-Functional Improvements
paper.abstract: Although coding agents have achieved impressive performance on correctness-oriented benchmarks, their ability to make behavior-preserving non-functional improvements (NFIs) remains underexplored. In real-world software development, developers continuously improve software quality without changing observable behavior, yet existing benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness and provide limited support for assessing these non-functional improvements.   In this paper, we present SWE-NFI, a

summary.core_problem: 构建一个评测 coding agents 做非功能性改进的 benchmark，而不只评估代码是否通过功能测试。
summary.importance: 贡献是 SWE/coding agent 评测资产。它补上了现有 correctness-oriented benchmark 的盲区：真实软件维护常常要求在行为不变的前提下改善质量、可维护性、性能或风格。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWE-NFI，从真实开源 Python 项目的已合并 pull requests 中构造 188 个任务，并把开发者导向的 non-functional improvements 操作化为 92 条可执行规则。评测同时包含功能正确性测试和规则化 NFI 检查。
summary.experiments: 评测了商业和开源 coding agents。摘要片段显示最佳 agent 在某个主要指标上达到 70.0%，但完整指标定义、各模型排名和失败类型需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a benchmark for evaluating coding agents on behavior-preserving non-functional improvements, beyond functional correctness.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an evaluation asset for SWE/coding agents. It targets a gap in correctness-oriented benchmarks: real software maintenance often requires quality improvements without observable behavioral changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-NFI contains 188 tasks derived from real merged pull requests in open-source Python projects. It operationalizes developer-oriented non-functional improvements into 92 executable rules and combines functional tests with rule-based NFI evaluation.
summary_en.experiments: The authors evaluate commercial and open-source coding agents. The abstract fragment reports that the best-performing agent reaches 70.0% on a main metric, but the exact metric, model ranking, and failure taxonomy require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；看任务构造和 92 条规则，能判断 coding posttrain 是否过拟合“修 bug”单一范式。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; inspect the task construction and 92 rules to see whether coding post-training is overfit to bug-fixing.

paper.title: ICAE-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Interactive Project Builders
paper.abstract: The recent emergence of vibe-coding workflows is changing what coding agents are expected to do. Instead of merely completing code under fully specified instructions, agents are increasingly expected to transform incomplete product intent into working software by combining various abilities including planning, requirement clarification, tool use, debugging, and repository-level construction. Yet existing benchmarks have not fully caught up with this shift, evaluating agents on static, fully spec

summary.core_problem: 现有代码 agent 评测大多基于静态、完全指定的任务，无法衡量 agent 在“vibe coding”场景下把模糊产品意图转化为可运行项目的能力，包括需求澄清、规划、工具使用、调试和仓库级构建。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，主要价值在评测侧：它把代码能力评测从局部补全推进到交互式项目构建，暴露了当前模型在“把澄清后的需求转化为连贯实现”上的瓶颈。对关心代码模型、长上下文、工具使用和 agent 后训练的研究者有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: ICAE-Bench 从真实开源仓库出发，先构造完整可执行的 GroundPRD 和黑盒行为测试，再通过隐藏部分约束生成模糊 PRD。隐藏约束由一个受约束的 User Agent 持有，被测 agent 可以通过提问逐步恢复信息。任务分 L1/L2/L3 三个模糊等级，对应不同的初始信息暴露程度。评测不要求复现原仓库实现，而是用黑盒功能测试结合产物、结构、交互层面的诊断来评估。
summary.experiments: 共 480 个任务，覆盖 12 种编程语言，另提供 50 任务的 ICAE-Bench-Lite。在 Claude Code 和 OpenHands 两个框架下测试 6 个代码模型。结果显示：GroundPRD 仍是强上界，交互只能恢复部分性能差距；提问覆盖率高不必然带来更高通过率，主要瓶颈不是是否提问，而是能否保留已澄清需求并转化为一致的仓库实现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看任务构造方式、模糊等级设计、User Agent 的信息边界，以及错误分析部分。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agent benchmarks mostly rely on static, fully specified tasks and do not measure whether agents can turn vague product intent into working software under vibe-coding workflows, including requirement clarification, planning, tool use, debugging, and repository-level construction.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited. Its main value is on the evaluation side: it moves coding evaluation from local completion toward interactive project building and highlights a bottleneck in converting clarified requirements into coherent implementations. It is useful for researchers working on code models, long context, tool use, and agent post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ICAE-Bench starts from real open-source repositories, constructs an executable GroundPRD with black-box behavioral tests, and then fuzzifies the requirement by hiding selected constraints. Hidden constraints are stored in a grounded User Agent that the tested agent can query. Tasks are organized into three fuzziness levels, L1/L2/L3, with progressively richer initial specifications. Evaluation does not require reproducing the original repository; it combines black-box functional tests with artifact-, structure-, and interaction-level diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 480 tasks across 12 programming languages, plus a 50-task ICAE-Bench-Lite subset. Six coding models are evaluated under Claude Code and OpenHands. GroundPRD remains a strong upper bound, and interaction recovers only part of the gap. Higher question coverage does not automatically yield higher pass rates. The main bottleneck is not asking questions, but preserving clarified requirements and converting them into coherent repository implementations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on task construction, the fuzziness levels, the information boundary of the User Agent, and the error analysis. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 编码Agent评测从静态单任务转向交互式项目构建的关键基准，重点看§3任务构造与§4评测协议设计即可。
recommendation.en: A key benchmark shifting coding agent evaluation from static single tasks to interactive project building; focus on §3 task construction and §4 evaluation protocol.

paper.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
paper.abstract: Real-world agent learning is often constrained by costly environment interactions, such as running time-consuming experiments or obtaining human feedback. In-context learning offers a highly sample-efficient way for agents to learn from their own interaction histories, but its gains disappear once that experience is removed from the context. Separately, context distillation provides a mechanism for internalizing contextual information into model weights. However, applying it to agents' interacti

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：在环境交互昂贵的 agent 场景里，如何把 in-context learning 从历史经验中获得的收益，尽量蒸馏进模型参数，而不再额外消耗环境交互样本。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 post-ICL / agent learning 接口上的方法创新。它不直接改 pretrain，但对“上下文中的经验能否被离线内化”为权重知识、以及如何在低交互预算下做 continual adaptation，有明确启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Experience Distillation：先收集 agent 的交互历史，再在不新增环境交互的前提下，把这些历史作为蒸馏源，将 ICL 中体现出的策略/经验转移到模型权重。论文强调这不同于直接对经验做 SFT，因为目标是保留 ICL 的行为收益，而不是仅拟合轨迹文本。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 749 个软件工程任务和 6 个文字冒险游戏。关键结果是：该方法在两个领域都能保留至少 64.8% 的 ICL 收益，而直接在收集到的经验上做监督微调只能恢复更少收益。摘要未给出底模规模、蒸馏细节和完整 baseline 列表，但从设定看，比较对象至少包括 ICL 上下文使用和直接 SFT。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to internalize gains from in-context learning over agent interaction histories into model weights, without requiring any additional environment interaction.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution at the agent-learning / post-ICL interface. It does not change pretraining directly, but it is relevant to continual adaptation under expensive interaction budgets and to the broader question of whether contextual experience can be converted into persistent parametric knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Experience Distillation: collect an agent's interaction history, then distill the behavior enabled by that history into the model parameters offline. The key distinction from naive supervised fine-tuning is that the goal is to preserve the gains of ICL from experience, not merely imitate logged trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover 749 curated software-engineering tasks and six text-adventure games. The headline result is that the method retains at least 64.8% of the gains from in-context learning across both domains, whereas direct supervised fine-tuning on the same collected experience recovers substantially less. The abstract does not specify base model sizes or full baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是直接增益，但它碰到一个真问题：上下文经验并不等价于 SFT 数据；只看实验设定和 ICL→weights 的蒸馏差距就够了。
recommendation.en: Not directly a pretraining paper, but it hits a real issue: contextual experience is not interchangeable with SFT data; the ICL-to-weights gap is the part worth reading.

paper.title: TRIM: Reducing AI-Generated CodeSlop via Agent Trajectory Minimization
paper.abstract: Coding agents are increasingly used to accelerate code generation in many downstream tasks, such as fixing bugs, building applications, and prototyping. However, despite their value as coding assistants, agent-generated code tends to be larger and more verbose than the corresponding human-written implementation. In this work, we show that the cause lies in the agent's own search process: while iterating toward a passing solution, an agent accumulates speculative edits, abandoned hypotheses, and

summary.core_problem: 解决 coding agent 在迭代搜索过程中把临时性、试探性修改残留到最终补丁里，导致代码冗长和可维护性下降的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个面向代码代理质量的系统性问题定义与方法工作，贡献不在基座预训练本身，而在于把“agent search 轨迹污染最终代码”这个现象形式化为 CodeSlop，并尝试用轨迹最小化来约束代理输出。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把问题归因到 agent 的搜索轨迹：代理在尝试通过测试时会累积投机性编辑、废弃假设和临时修补。核心方法 TRIM 通过最小化 agent trajectory，压缩或回退不必要的中间编辑，力图保留能通过验证的最小补丁。方法上更像对 agent editing process 的后处理/约束，而不是新模型架构。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可知，工作关注 bug fixing、应用构建、原型开发等 coding agent 场景，并比较 agent 生成补丁与人工实现的长度和冗余。摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据集名称和量化提升幅度，因此当前只能判断实验重点是补丁尺寸、冗余度和可维护性，而不是基座能力提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Petros Maniatis、Junfeng Yang、Baishakhi Ray，均在系统、程序分析与软件工程方向有代表性积累；该工作更接近软件工程与 coding agent 交叉。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the tendency of coding agents to leave speculative and temporary edits in final patches, producing verbose code that is harder to maintain.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not about foundation-model pretraining, but about formalizing a real failure mode of coding agents—CodeSlop—and proposing a trajectory-minimization remedy for agent-generated code quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper attributes bloated patches to the agent search process itself: speculative edits, abandoned hypotheses, and temporary fixes survive into the final solution. TRIM minimizes the agent trajectory, aiming to compress away unnecessary intermediate edits while preserving a passing patch. This is a process-level intervention rather than a new model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation spans coding-agent use cases such as bug fixing, app building, and prototyping, comparing agent-generated patches against human-written implementations in verbosity and redundancy. The abstract does not expose model sizes, datasets, or exact gains, so the main experimental signal appears to be patch compactness and maintainability rather than base-model capability.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Petros Maniatis, Junfeng Yang, and Baishakhi Ray, all well known in systems, program analysis, and software engineering; the work sits more in the coding-agent/software-engineering intersection.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 agent 生成代码为何越来越臃肿讲得很像真实生产问题；看问题定义即可，方法细节未必能迁到基座训练。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the diagnosis of why agent-written code bloats feels operationally real; read for the failure mode, not for transferable base-model methodology.

paper.title: DeepSWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Original, Long-Horizon Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: DeepSWE is a benchmark of 113 original, long-horizon software engineering tasks for evaluating coding agents. Most public agentic coding benchmarks follow SWE-bench in mining merged fixes from public GitHub repositories, which creates two problems: the fixes and their discussion were likely seen during pretraining, so a high score can reflect recall rather than problem-solving; and each task is graded by the tests that shipped with its merged fix, which were written to confirm one specific fix r

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是代码 Agent 评测中的两个结构性问题：从公开 GitHub 合并补丁挖任务会带来预训练污染风险；用原补丁附带测试做评分，容易把某个特定实现当成唯一答案，导致正确替代实现被拒绝，或不完整实现被放过。
summary.importance: 它的核心贡献是评测资产，不是训练方法。对基座和 post-train 研究的启发在于，代码能力评估必须区分记忆公开补丁和解决新工程问题。对于代码预训练、SFT/RL 数据选择、agentic coding 训练信号设计，这类 benchmark 能更清楚地暴露模型在真实仓库探索、多文件修改、长程调试上的短板，也能减少 leaderboard 被数据污染误导的风险。
summary.technical_approach: DeepSWE 构造了 113 个原创长程软件工程任务，覆盖 91 个活跃开源仓库和 5 种语言：TypeScript、Go、Python、JavaScript、Rust。任务从零编写，参考解不会合并回上游仓库；评测容器只提供 base commit 的 shallow clone，避免 .git 历史泄漏参考修复。Prompt 设计接近开发者给 Agent 的自然需求描述，较短且不过度指定接口，让 Agent 自行定位代码、跨文件修改、运行测试并迭代。评分侧使用人工编写的 functional verifier，关注可观察的软件行为，而不是匹配某个实现细节。
summary.experiments: DeepSWE 的任务规模相对更长：prompt 约为 SWE-Bench Pro 的一半长度，但参考解需要约 5.5 倍代码量和约 2 倍输出 token。论文报告 DeepSWE 覆盖 113 个任务、91 个仓库，仓库分布比 SWE-Bench Pro Public 的 11 个仓库和 SWE-Bench Verified 的 12 个仓库更分散。独立 LLM-as-judge 审计中，DeepSWE 的 pass/fail 判定与 judge 分歧约 1.4%，而 SWE-Bench Pro 被审计 rollout 的分歧约为三分之一。作者还指出 SWE-Bench Pro 容器中存在 .git 历史泄漏风险，部分 Claude Opus rollout 能从容器历史中恢复参考修复。模型结果上，DeepSWE 让一些在公开 benchmark 上接近的模型配置拉开差距，但它只比较固定 harness 下的模型能力，不等同于评价完整代码产品。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 benchmark construction：任务如何原创、为什么不合并上游、容器如何避免历史泄漏；再看 verifier 设计和 LLM-as-judge 审计，这部分决定评测可信度。实验部分优先看任务长度、仓库覆盖、语言分布、与 SWE-Bench Pro / SWE-Bench Verified 的对比，以及 leaderboard 结果。对预训练研究员，最值得保留的是污染控制和评分信号设计，而不是具体模型排名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two weaknesses in public coding-agent benchmarks: tasks mined from merged GitHub fixes are exposed to pretraining contamination, and grading with the tests attached to the original patch can reward or reject solutions for reasons tied to one specific implementation rather than the intended behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining method. Its value for foundation-model research is that it separates memorization of public patches from solving new engineering tasks. For code pretraining, SFT/RL data design, and agentic coding evaluation, the benchmark gives a cleaner signal on repository exploration, multi-file editing, long-horizon implementation, and iterative testing.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeepSWE contains 113 original long-horizon engineering tasks across 91 active open-source repositories and five languages: TypeScript, Go, Python, JavaScript, and Rust. The reference solutions are written from scratch and are never contributed upstream, reducing the chance that they appear in public pretraining corpora. The evaluation containers use shallow clones at the base commit, avoiding leakage through repository history. Prompts are short and natural, closer to how developers ask agents for functionality, so agents must infer where and how to implement the change. Grading uses hand-written functional verifiers that test observable software behavior rather than implementation details.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is designed to be harder and less prescriptive than common SWE-style datasets. Its prompts are about half the length of SWE-Bench Pro prompts, while reference solutions require roughly 5.5 times more code and about 2 times more output tokens. It covers 91 repositories, compared with 11 for SWE-Bench Pro Public and 12 for SWE-Bench Verified. In an independent LLM-as-judge audit, DeepSWE pass/fail labels disagreed with the judge in about 1.4% of audited cases, while SWE-Bench Pro disagreed in roughly one third of audited rollouts. The paper also reports a packaging leakage issue in SWE-Bench Pro: some Claude Opus rollouts recovered reference fixes from the shipped .git history. On model comparisons, DeepSWE separates configurations that look closer on public benchmarks, but the leaderboard is explicitly tied to a fixed harness and should not be read as a ranking of coding products.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the benchmark construction details: how tasks are authored, why solutions are not merged upstream, and how shallow clones prevent history leakage. Then read the verifier design and the LLM-as-judge audit, since those sections determine whether the scores are trustworthy. The most useful experimental parts are the comparisons on prompt length, solution size, repository coverage, language distribution, and the leaderboard under the fixed harness. For pretraining researchers, the durable lessons are contamination control and verifier quality, not the exact ordering of models.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 benchmark design；它把 SWE 评测里 contamination 和 oracle 偏置两个老问题拆得很干净。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark design; it cleanly isolates two persistent SWE-eval problems: contamination and biased test oracles.

paper.title: SWE-Router: Routing in Multi-turn Agentic Software Engineering Tasks
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) embedded in multi-turn agentic harnesses are reshaping software engineering (SWE), but routing every task to a frontier model is wasteful when many issues admit cheap fixes. Existing LLM routers operate on the task description alone, which inherits an information-theoretic Bayes-error floor in agentic settings: a similar issue can hide either a localized typo or a multi-module refactor, and the prompt does not separate the two. We introduce SWE-Router, a value-based

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM路由方法仅基于任务描述做模型选择，在多轮智能体软件工程（SWE）场景中存在贝叶斯误差下限：相同的问题描述可能对应简单拼写错误修复，也可能需要多模块重构，仅靠题目信息无法区分，导致不必要的算力浪费。
summary.importance: 提出时序路由的新思路，将模型选择决策从任务开始前延迟到弱模型探索之后，利用智能体自身生成的中间轨迹信息做路由，可为降低多轮智能体场景的推理成本提供实际参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是基于价值的时序路由框架SWE-Router。1. 先用低成本弱模型运行K轮探索，生成包含思考、动作、环境观测的部分轨迹；2. 训练一个附加在预训练LLM上的小分类头作为价值函数，以任务最终成功的二值奖励为监督，预测弱模型能否完成任务；3. 若预测值超过成本调整阈值则继续使用弱模型，否则升级到强模型（升级后强模型从原始问题重新开始，避免被弱模型的错误带偏）。论文还证明了贝叶斯最优性：基于部分轨迹的路由决策不会差于仅基于prompt的决策。
summary.experiments: 在SWEBench-Verified数据集上，相比仅基于prompt的强基线路由方法，在匹配解决率的前提下实现了显著的成本降低。所提供的部分内容未包含具体数值，详细数据需参考完整论文的实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看第3章时序路由框架的设计逻辑和第4章的贝叶斯最优性证明，理解核心创新点；实验部分关注成本-性能帕累托曲线的对比结果。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM routers select models solely based on task descriptions, which suffers from a Bayes-error floor in multi-turn agentic software engineering (SWE) settings: identical issue descriptions can correspond to either trivial typo fixes or multi-module refactors, and prompt-only information cannot distinguish the two, leading to unnecessary compute waste.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a new temporal routing paradigm that defers model selection until after exploratory steps by a weak model, leveraging intermediate trajectory signals generated by the agent itself. This provides practical reference for reducing inference costs in multi-turn agentic scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is SWE-Router, a value-based temporal routing framework. 1) A low-cost weak model first runs K exploratory turns to generate a partial trajectory containing thoughts, actions, and environment observations. 2) A value head (a small classification head attached to a pretrained LLM) is trained with binary task success rewards to predict whether the weak model can eventually solve the task. 3) If the predicted value exceeds a cost-adjusted threshold, the weak model continues; otherwise, the task is escalated to a stronger model (which restarts from the original problem to avoid being biased by the weak model's mistakes). A Bayes-optimality theorem proves that routing conditioned on partial trajectories is never worse than prompt-only routing.
summary_en.experiments: On SWEBench-Verified, SWE-Router achieves substantial cost reductions at matched resolution rates relative to strong prompt-only routing baselines. Detailed numerical results are not available in the provided partial content and should be referenced from the full paper's experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: Focus on Section 3 (design of the temporal routing framework) and Section 4 (Bayes-optimality proof) to grasp the core insight. For experiments, pay attention to the cost-performance Pareto curve comparisons. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读定理和成本-质量曲线；它把 router 从静态 prompt 拉到执行轨迹，适合复用到内部 agent 预算分配实验。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem and cost-quality curves; shifting routing from static prompts to execution traces is worth testing in internal agent budget allocation.

paper.title: ATM: CID-Brokered Pre-Write Admission for Multi-Agent Code Co-Synthesis
paper.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems can decompose software-engineering work into planning, generation, validation, and repair, but a narrower systems problem remains: before any governed shared mutation is applied, a system must decide which concurrently formed write intents may proceed in parallel, which require deterministic composition or serialization, and which must take a fail-closed path. We address this problem with the AI-Atomic-Framework (ATM), a specification-grounded governance substrate for sof

summary.core_problem: 解决多 Agent 代码协作中共享仓库写入前的准入治理问题：哪些并发写意图可并行、哪些要组合或串行、哪些必须保守拒绝。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统规范与执行治理。它关注的是 SWE Agent 在真实代码库中进行共享 mutation 时的冲突控制、证据链和 fail-closed 策略，而不是代码生成模型本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AI-Atomic-Framework，将任务意图、仓库作用域、写入准入、验证和证据义务绑定为一条治理链。核心组件是 CID broker，用内容标识符管理共享 mutation 准入；adapter-guided atomization 将写意图映射到语义 atom 和受限区域；当持久 atom-map 覆盖不足时，用 virtual atoms 做临时、可审计的保守路由。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、数据集、基线或量化结果。论文看起来更像架构/规范型系统方案，实验可信度需要看正文是否有真实仓库、多 Agent 并发冲突和回滚场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses pre-write admission control for multi-agent code co-synthesis: deciding which concurrent write intents can run in parallel, which must be composed or serialized, and which should fail closed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a systems-governance design for SWE agents. It targets shared repository mutation, conflict control, evidence obligations, and conservative routing rather than improving the underlying code model.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes the AI-Atomic-Framework, binding task intent, repository scope, write admission, validation, and evidence into one governance chain. A CID broker handles shared-mutation admission; adapter-guided atomization maps write intents into semantic atoms and bounded regions; virtual atoms are used as temporary auditable units when persistent atom-map coverage is incomplete.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results. The paper appears to be a specification/system design, and its value depends on whether the full text includes realistic repository-level concurrency and rollback cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看写入准入模型即可；对预训练没直接信号，但暴露了 SWE Agent 落地时常被低估的共享 mutation 坑。
recommendation.en: Read only the admission model; it does not inform pretraining directly, but it captures a real shared-mutation failure mode in SWE agents.

paper.title: An Empirical Study of Security Calibration in Large Language Models for Code
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming software development, yet their use in security-critical contexts raises a key question: do models know when their generated code is insecure? This property, known as calibration, measures whether a model's confidence aligns with the true correctness of its outputs. We present the first large-scale empirical study of security calibration in LLM-generated code. We evaluate GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and Qwen3-Coder-Next across multiple tem

summary.core_problem: 评估代码 LLM 是否知道自己生成的代码不安全，即模型置信度是否与安全性和功能正确性对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码 LLM 安全校准的实证分析。它不提出新训练方法，但把 security calibration 和 functional calibration 分开测量，对代码模型后训练、拒答策略和自动修复流程有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在多个 temperature 设置下评估 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash 和 Qwen3-Coder-Next，覆盖自包含安全任务和多语言 repository-level context；核心是比较模型置信度、生成代码的安全结果和功能正确性之间的校准误差，并分析 calibration-guided 自动策略是否有效。
summary.experiments: 实验模型包括 GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash、Qwen3-Coder-Next。摘要称多模型普遍过度自信；functional calibration consistently worse than security calibration，作者推测功能正确性更依赖复杂执行行为，因此模型更难估计。具体 benchmark 名称、ECE/Brier 等指标和温度敏感性需读正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether code LLMs know when their generated code is insecure, i.e. whether their confidence is calibrated to security and functional correctness outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical analysis of security calibration in code LLMs. It does not introduce a new training method, but the separation between security and functional calibration is useful for post-training, refusal policies, and automated code-repair pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study evaluates GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and Qwen3-Coder-Next across temperature settings on self-contained security tasks and multi-language repository-level contexts. It compares model confidence against security outcomes and functional correctness, and examines whether calibration-guided automation helps.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluated models are GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and Qwen3-Coder-Next. The abstract reports widespread overconfidence and finds functional calibration consistently worse than security calibration, possibly because functional correctness depends on more complex execution behavior. Exact benchmark names, calibration metrics, and temperature effects require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看结果表和温度分析；结论偏工程评测，但“安全比功能更可校准”这个现象可作为代码 RL 信号设计的弱证据。
recommendation.en: Read only the result tables and temperature analysis; the work is mostly empirical, but the security-vs-function calibration gap is a useful weak signal for code RL design.

paper.title: Govern the Repository, Not the Agent: Measuring Ecosystem-Level Risk in AI-Native Software
paper.abstract: Autonomous coding agents now open and merge pull requests in shared repositories at scale, and the field evaluates them the way it has always evaluated components, one agent at a time, on isolated benchmark tasks. Yet agents that each pass their own tests still leave repositories that accumulate problems no single contribution accounts for. We ask whether this problem belongs to the individual agent or to the repository where it accumulates. We study integration friction, the cost of integrating

summary.core_problem: 评估自主 coding agents 的风险时，单独看每个 agent 或每个 PR 是否通过测试，无法解释仓库层面积累的集成摩擦。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 评测视角和大规模实证测量。它把风险单位从单个 agent/任务切到 repository ecosystem，对 SWE-agent 评测设计有价值，但对 LLM 基座预训练只有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义并测量 integration friction，即把一个贡献集成进同时被其他贡献改变的代码库所需的成本。通过控制贡献内容、作者、规模和 agent 等变量，估计摩擦中有多少方差稳定归属于仓库层面，并比较 agent-authored 与 human-authored PR 的集中程度。
summary.experiments: 分析超过 930,000 个 agent-authored pull requests。摘要称在完整控制后，约一半 friction 变异仍停留在 repository 层面；同一批仓库中，agent-authored contributions 对仓库层摩擦的集中程度约为 human contributions 的两倍，摘要给出 intraclass correlation 开头为 0，但数值被截断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that evaluating autonomous coding agents one PR or one agent at a time misses repository-level integration friction that accumulates across contributions.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and large-scale measurement contribution for coding agents. It shifts the unit of risk from the individual agent or task to the repository ecosystem, with indirect relevance to LLM training and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study measures integration friction, defined as the cost of integrating a contribution into a codebase undergoing concurrent changes. It controls for contribution, author, size, and agent factors to estimate how much variance remains attributable to the repository, then compares agent-authored and human-authored PRs.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers more than 930,000 agent-authored pull requests. The abstract reports that about half of the friction variation remains at the repository level after full controls, and that agent-authored contributions concentrate repository-level friction roughly twice as much as human contributions.

recommendation.zh: 预训练人不用细读，但 Fig/Table 中的仓库层 ICC 会提醒 coding-agent eval 别只盯单任务通过率。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for pretraining, but the repository-level ICC is a useful warning against single-task pass-rate evaluation for coding agents.

paper.title: The Spec Growth Engine: Spec-Anchored, Code-Coupled, Drift-Enforced Architecture for AI-Assisted Software Development
paper.abstract: AI coding agents dramatically accelerate implementation speed but introduce two structural failure modes that existing spec-driven approaches do not fully solve: (1) context explosion -- the agent must reason over an entire repository at once, degrading output quality as the context window fills; and (2) silent spec-code drift -- code evolves, the specification does not, and the divergence becomes invisible until it is costly to repair.   We present the Spec Growth Engine, a lightweight framewor

summary.core_problem: 解决AI编码助手存在的上下文爆炸、规格-代码漂移两大结构性失效问题
summary.importance: 工程框架创新，将经典软件工程原则与AI编码工作流结合，提出轻量级规格驱动开发架构
summary.technical_approach: 构建机器可读规格图（契约/设计分离节点）、Spine上下文组装器（按所有权路径限定上下文）、垂直切片最难优先增长协议、漂移门（规格代码分歧阻塞合并）
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体量化实验结果，仅说明设计综合了多个软件工程经典原则

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two structural failure modes of AI coding agents: context explosion and silent spec-code drift in AI-assisted software development
summary_en.importance: Engineering framework innovation integrating classical software engineering principles into AI coding workflows, proposing a lightweight spec-driven development architecture
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds machine-readable spec graph with contract/design separation, Spine context assembler scoping context to ownership paths, vertical-slice hardest-first growth protocol, and drift gate blocking merges on spec-code divergence
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative experimental results provided in the abstract; design is stated to synthesize multiple classical software engineering principles

recommendation.zh: 软件工程原则嵌入AI编码工作流的工程方案，无基座预训练相关insight，仅作coding agent工程参考
recommendation.en: Engineering solution integrating SE principles into AI coding workflows, no foundation pretraining insights, only for coding agent engineering reference

paper.title: CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation
paper.abstract: Natural language to repository generation (NL2Repo) requires a system to construct an entire software repository from a natural-language requirements document. Compared with function-level code generation, this task demands longer planning horizons, stable interfaces across files, and iterative debugging of cross-file inconsistencies. To address these challenges, we propose CodeTeam, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that separates planning, decision making, and implementation into distinct, co

summary.core_problem: 解决自然语言到完整软件仓库生成（NL2Repo）中长程规划、跨文件接口一致性与迭代调试的核心挑战
summary.importance: 代码Agent架构创新，提出多角色分离的多Agent协作框架，为仓库级代码生成提供新范式
summary.technical_approach: CodeTeam框架分三阶段：多Architect agent生成竞争的软件设计草图，CTO agent筛选并规范化为可机器检查的接口契约，Developer agent按依赖调度生成代码，配合轻量Git协作机制
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体使用的LLM模型、测试数据集与基线效果对比的量化结果

summary_en.core_problem: Address core challenges of long-horizon planning, cross-file interface consistency and iterative debugging in NL2Repo (natural language to full software repository generation)
summary_en.importance: Coding agent architecture innovation, proposes a role-separated multi-agent collaboration framework as a new paradigm for repository-level code generation
summary_en.technical_approach: CodeTeam has three stages: multiple Architect agents draft competing software design sketches, CTO agent selects and normalizes them into machine-checkable interface contracts, Developer agents generate code under dependency-aware scheduler with lightweight Git coordination
summary_en.experiments: No specific LLM models, test datasets or quantitative baseline comparison results disclosed in abstract

recommendation.zh: 仓库级代码生成的多Agent角色划分有参考价值，仅看框架图Fig1和§3的流程设计即可
recommendation.en: Role-separated multi-agent design for repo-level code generation is reference-worthy; only check Fig 1 and §3 pipeline design.

paper.title: SWE-Future: Forecast-Conditioned Data Synthesis for Future-Oriented Software Engineering Agents
paper.abstract: Realistic coding-agent benchmarks often replay public GitHub issues and pull requests, making them vulnerable to overlap with model pretraining, fine-tuning, synthetic-data generation, or benchmark-driven model selection. Fully synthetic tasks avoid direct historical replay, but can drift away from real repository needs. We propose SWE-Future, a forecast-conditioned data synthesis method for future-oriented coding tasks. Given a forecast snapshot at time $T_0$, the method uses only pre-$T_0$ rep

summary.core_problem: 现有代码Agent基准要么直接回放历史GitHub PR，存在和预训练/微调/合成数据管线的污染风险，要么使用完全合成的任务，脱离真实仓库的实际开发优先级与约束，缺少同时保证任务真实性、无信息泄漏、符合仓库真实演进方向的代码任务构造方法。
summary.importance: 该工作解决了代码类训练数据与评测基准的污染难题，其时间隔离、预测驱动的合成思路对构造无泄漏的代码SFT/RL训练数据、干净的代码Agent评测集有直接实用价值，任务族预测的逻辑也可迁移到其他快速演进领域的训练/评测数据构造。
summary.technical_approach: 提出预测条件式数据合成框架SWE-Future，设置三个严格的时间节点实现信息隔离：1）预测快照T0：仅使用T0之前的仓库证据（issue、PR、标签、代码文本）预测未来的任务族，覆盖功能新增/增强、bug修复、重构三类开发活动，不预测具体的未来PR；2）回溯验证窗口(T0, T1]：冻结预测结果后，仅使用T0到T1之间的PR元数据验证预测的任务族是否匹配真实未来开发方向，丢弃未通过验证的任务族；3）任务生成快照Tgen：以验证通过的任务族为条件，基于Tgen时刻的仓库状态合成具体编码任务，再经过目标测试构造、泄漏检查、FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS校验过滤不合格任务。
summary.experiments: 在80个Python生态仓库上开展回溯验证，任务族预测的未来工作相关性在主语义匹配指标下达到58.1%；最终构造了覆盖61个仓库、包含200个可执行验证任务的代码Agent数据集，所有任务严格遵守信息边界，不存在历史PR回放带来的数据污染问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注方法部分的时间边界设计（图2）、选择任务族而非具体PR作为预测单元的设计逻辑、最终的任务校验过滤流程，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing coding agent benchmarks either replay historical GitHub pull requests, which carries non-trivial data contamination risk for pretraining, fine-tuning, and synthetic data pipelines, or use fully synthetic tasks that drift away from real development priorities and constraints of production repositories. No prior approach balances task realism, strict leakage prevention, and alignment with actual repository evolution trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the growing contamination problem in coding post-training datasets and evaluation benchmarks. Its time-isolated, forecast-driven synthesis design provides a practical template for building uncontaminated SFT/RL training data and clean coding agent test sets, and the task family prediction logic can generalize to data construction for other fast-evolving domains.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Future implements a forecast-conditioned synthesis pipeline with three strict temporal cutoffs to enforce information boundaries: 1) Forecast snapshot T0: Only pre-T0 repository evidence (issues, PRs, labels, codebase text) is used to predict future task families covering feature additions/enhancements, bug fixes, and refactoring work, without forecasting exact future PRs. 2) Retrospective validation window (T0, T1]: Predictions are frozen, and post-T0 PR metadata is only used to check whether predicted families match actual future development activity, with unvalidated families discarded. 3) Task generation snapshot Tgen: Validated task families are used as conditioning signals to generate concrete coding tasks from the Tgen repository state, followed by a filtering pipeline including target test construction, leakage checks, and FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS validation.
summary_en.experiments: Retrospective evaluation across 80 Python ecosystem repositories shows the forecaster achieves 58.1% future work relevance under the primary semantic matching metric. The final released dataset contains 200 executable coding tasks across 61 repositories, all constructed with strict information controls to eliminate contamination from historical PR replay.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on the temporal boundary design (Figure 2), the rationale for using task families instead of exact PRs as the forecast unit, and the final task validation pipeline. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和污染控制 setup；58.1% 相关性不高，但时间截断评测协议比又一批 GitHub replay 更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method and contamination-control setup; 58.1% relevance is modest, but the temporal-cutoff protocol is cleaner than another GitHub replay benchmark.

paper.title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, har

summary.core_problem: 这篇 position paper 的核心问题是：现有 coding benchmark 仍在评估“单个模型一次性生成代码”的能力，但实际 coding agent 是模型、prompt、工具、环境、上下文和反馈信号组成的系统。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对代码模型和 agent 评测有启发。它提醒研究者不要把 SWE-Bench、HumanEval、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、BigCodeBench 这类端到端分数简单归因于 base model 或 post-train 方法。对于训练代码模型，benchmark signal 的归因错误会反过来影响数据构造、RL 环境设计和 verifier 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 论文没有提出新模型，而是重新定义 coding agent 的评测对象。作者区分 agent harness 和 system harness：前者是单个模型在工具循环中解决任务，后者负责把高层目标拆成任务、调度一个或多个 agent、管理仓库和运行环境、组织上下文、收集反馈。系统被分解为五个组件：tasks、agent harnesses、environment、context、feedback signals。反馈又按时延和可信度分为 inner-loop、middle-loop、outer-loop。inner-loop 包括测试、类型检查、lint、编译；middle-loop 包括代码审查、仿真、维护性检查；outer-loop 包括 PR 接受率、revert、事故和用户反馈。作者认为更合理的 coding benchmark 应该给出组件级信号，使用独立行为规格而不是单一参考答案，并显式度量系统在迭代和反馈中的表现。
summary.experiments: 这不是一篇实验论文，没有受控实验或标准 benchmark 结果。证据主要来自对现有 coding benchmark 的结构性分析，以及作者开源的 NS2 系统 harness 经验。NS2 使用 issue 作为协调单位，运行包含工具调用的 agent loop，并引入严格 verifier、middle-loop review、outer-loop friction/revert 信号。论文的关键观察是：harness、环境、上下文和反馈设计带来的分数变化，可能接近相邻模型代际之间的差距，因此单一端到端分数不足以支持模型能力归因。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 The System Harnesses 一节，里面对 agent harness、system harness、五个组件和三层反馈的拆分最有用。Three Symptoms of the Misalignment 一节可快速扫读，主要抓住三点：模型与 harness 混淆、单一参考答案不适合真实软件工程、缺少迭代过程和组件级信号。对做代码模型训练或 RL 环境的人，最值得带走的是 verifier 和 feedback signal 的分层，而不是具体的 NS2 实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that current coding benchmarks evaluate an older object of study: a model producing code in a mostly fixed harness. Real coding agents are composite systems made of models, prompts, tools, environments, context management, and feedback loops.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not directly about pretraining, but it matters for code-model evaluation and agentic RL setups. It warns against attributing an end-to-end SWE-Bench-style score to the base model alone. Harness design, environment setup, context construction, and verifier quality can move scores by margins comparable to model-generation differences. For code model training, this affects how evaluation signals are interpreted and how synthetic tasks, verifiers, and feedback loops should be designed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is a benchmark-position argument rather than a new algorithm. The paper separates an agent harness from a system harness. An agent harness is a model in a tool-use loop for a single task. A system harness sits outside it: it converts higher-level goals into tasks, dispatches one or more agent harnesses, manages the repository and runtime environment, curates context, and routes feedback. The system is decomposed into five parts: tasks, agent harnesses, environment, context, and feedback signals. Feedback is further divided into inner-loop signals such as tests, type checks, linting, and compilation; middle-loop signals such as review, simulation, and maintainability checks; and outer-loop signals such as PR acceptance, reverts, incidents, and user outcomes. The proposed benchmark direction is to expose component-level measurements and grade against independent behavioral specifications rather than a single reference solution.
summary_en.experiments: There are no controlled experiments or new benchmark numbers. The evidence is an analysis of existing coding benchmarks and practical observations from NS2, an open-source issue-driven system harness described by the authors. NS2 uses deterministic checks and agent-arbitrated checks, including strict verifiers, middle-loop review, and outer-loop friction or revert signals. The main empirical claim is qualitative: changes in harness, context, environment, and feedback can produce score movements large enough to confound model comparisons.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time is about 15–20 minutes. The most useful part is the system-harness section, especially the distinction between agent harness and system harness, the five-component decomposition, and the three-tier feedback taxonomy. The misalignment section can be read for the three main failure modes: conflating model and harness, grading against a single reference solution, and losing iteration-level or component-level signal. For researchers working on code-model post-training or RL environments, the feedback taxonomy is the main reusable idea.

recommendation.zh: 对理解 SWE-bench 类分数有帮助，但偏立场文章；直接读三个症状和结论即可，别期待方法。
recommendation.en: Useful framing for interpreting coding-agent leaderboards, but it is a position piece; read the three symptoms and stop.

paper.title: All Smoke, No Alarm: Oracle Signals in Agent-Authored Test Code
paper.abstract: Software practitioners increasingly use AI coding agents that generate test code alongside production code in open source pull requests (PRs). Recent studies report more than 932,000 agent-authored PRs across more than 116,000 repositories, yet whether their test files contain meaningful verification logic remains underexplored. Test files lacking explicit assertions execute code without verifying behavior, so quality gates based on test-file presence overestimate verification strength. The goal

summary.core_problem: AI编码agent生成的测试代码常缺少有意义的验证逻辑（oracle signals），导致基于'测试文件存在与否'的质量门控高估了实际验证强度
summary.importance: 实证研究贡献：首次大规模系统分析agent生成测试代码的验证质量
summary.technical_approach: 对86156个测试文件补丁（来自5个coding agent：Codex、Copilot、Devin、Cursor、Claude Code）进行定性+定量分析，构建8种oracle signal的句法分类法，关联合并结果和评审工作量
summary.experiments: 33596个PR，2807个GitHub仓库，384个分层样本的定性分析

summary_en.core_problem: AI coding agents generate test code that often lacks meaningful verification logic (oracle signals), so quality gates based on test-file presence overestimate actual verification strength
summary_en.importance: Empirical analysis contribution: first large-scale systematic study of verification quality in agent-authored test code
summary_en.technical_approach: Qualitative + quantitative analysis of 86,156 test-file patches from 5 coding agents (Codex, Copilot, Devin, Cursor, Claude Code); develops a syntactic taxonomy of 8 oracle signal types; correlates with merge outcomes and review effort
summary_en.experiments: 33,596 PRs across 2,807 GitHub repositories; qualitative analysis of 384 stratified samples

recommendation.zh: 软件工程领域的实证分析，揭示coding agent生成测试代码的质量问题，对预训练研究无直接启发，glance即可
recommendation.en: Empirical software engineering study revealing test-code quality issues in coding agent output; no direct pretraining insight; glance only

paper.title: Multi-task LLMs for Bug Classification: Efficient Inference with Auxiliary Decoding Heads
paper.abstract: The rapid adoption of LLM-powered code generation has dramatically accelerated software development, yet effective verification methods remain severely underdeveloped. Existing bug localization techniques are either prohibitively expensive, requiring minutes of agentic reasoning and thousands of generated tokens per file, and/or operate at coarse function-level granularity unsuitable for precise debugging. While works that focus on line-level granularity and are more light-weight are often limit

summary.core_problem: 降低 LLM 做行级 bug localization 的推理成本，同时保持足够细粒度的定位能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是软件工程场景下的代码模型应用方法。它不推进基座预训练，但涉及辅助 decoding heads、多任务训练和 token-line 对齐，对代码模型的高效监督头设计有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含三部分：一是 token alignment algorithm，处理 tokenizer 与源码行级标签之间的不匹配；二是 lightweight multi-task LLM for bug localization，通过辅助 decoding heads 做行级 bug classification；三是面向 multi-line prediction 的训练 recipe。整体思路是把昂贵的 agentic reasoning 替换为一次或少数几次前向中的分类式预测。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在同类轻量行级 bug localization 方法中取得领先表现，但未给出模型大小、数据集、基线列表或提升幅度。主要对比对象是需要分钟级 agentic reasoning、每个文件生成数千 token 的方法，以及上下文或性能受限的轻量方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to reduce the inference cost of LLM-based line-level bug localization while retaining fine-grained localization.
summary_en.importance: This is a software-engineering method rather than a foundation-model pretraining contribution. The auxiliary decoding-head design and token-to-line alignment may be mildly useful for code-model supervision heads.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has three components: a token alignment algorithm for mapping tokenizer outputs to line-level labels, a lightweight multi-task LLM with auxiliary decoding heads for line-level bug classification, and a training recipe for multi-line prediction. The goal is to replace expensive agentic reasoning with classification-style predictions from a compact LLM setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports leading performance among similar lightweight line-level bug localization methods, but does not provide model size, datasets, baselines, or numeric gains. The main contrast is against expensive agentic methods that require minutes and thousands of generated tokens per file, and lighter methods with limited context or performance.

recommendation.zh: 只看辅助 head 和 token-line 对齐即可；这是代码缺陷定位工程文，不会改变代码基座训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim only the auxiliary-head and token-line alignment pieces; this is an engineering paper for bug localization, not a signal for code pretraining.

paper.title: SWE-Explore: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Explore Repositories
paper.abstract: Repository-level coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench have driven a rapid surge in the capabilities of coding agents. Yet they usually treat coding tasks as a holistic, binary prediction problem (e.g., resolved or unresolved), neglecting fine-grained agent capabilities such as repository understanding, context retrieval, code localization, and bug diagnosis. In this paper, we introduce SWE-Explore, a benchmark that isolates the evaluation of repository exploration, a critical capability of coding

summary.core_problem: SWE类基准通常只看最终是否修复成功，无法分离代码代理在仓库探索、上下文检索和定位上的真实能力；这篇工作专门评测“探索仓库”这一步。
summary.importance: 这是一个较有价值的coding-agent评测资产。贡献不在新agent，而在把仓库级代码理解拆成可测的中间能力，对分析代理失败模式和训练数据构造都有帮助。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SWE-Explore：给定仓库和issue，在固定行数预算下输出相关代码区域的排序列表。数据覆盖848个issue、10种语言、203个开源仓库。line-level ground truth来自独立成功代理轨迹中实际访问过的代码区域，从而把“探索”从端到端修复中剥离出来，并用coverage、ranking等指标评估。
summary.experiments: 基准规模为848 issues / 203 repos / 10 languages。核心实验是比较不同探索器在固定预算下对关键代码区域的覆盖与排序质量，而不是最终patch成功率。摘要未给出具体SOTA数字，但其设计明显优于只看resolved/unresolved的粗粒度评测。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自上海交大、UIUC、港中大等。虽然不是顶级实验室发布，但题目切得准：把repository exploration单独拿出来测，适合作为coding-agent训练与分析的中间评估。

summary_en.core_problem: Repository-level coding benchmarks usually collapse everything into final issue resolution, making it hard to isolate how well coding agents explore repositories, retrieve context, and localize code; this paper evaluates the exploration step directly.
summary_en.importance: This is a useful coding-agent evaluation asset. The contribution is not a new agent, but a cleaner decomposition of repository-level code understanding into a measurable intermediate capability, which can help failure analysis and training-data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Explore asks an explorer, given a repository and an issue, to return a ranked list of relevant code regions under a fixed line budget. It covers 848 issues, 10 languages, and 203 repositories. Line-level ground truth is derived from independent successful agent trajectories by distilling the code regions actually consulted, thereby isolating exploration from end-to-end patch generation and evaluating it with coverage and ranking metrics.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark spans 848 issues, 203 repos, and 10 languages. The main experiments compare explorers under a fixed budget on coverage and ranking quality of relevant code regions rather than final patch success. The abstract does not report headline SOTA numbers, but the setup is clearly cleaner than binary resolved/unresolved evaluation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, UIUC, CUHK, and others. It is not a top-lab release, but the problem framing is sharp: repository exploration is isolated as its own measurable capability for coding-agent training and analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这个切分是对的：先别迷信 SWE-bench 终局分数，仓库探索本身就该单独测；读任务定义和 ground-truth 构造即可。
recommendation.en: This decomposition is the right move: stop over-trusting end-to-end SWE scores, because repository exploration deserves its own benchmark; read the task definition and ground-truth construction.
