paper.title: Socratic-SWE: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Trace-Derived Agent Skills
paper.abstract: LLM-driven software engineering agents have become a central testbed for real-world language-model capability, yet their training remains limited by the availability of high-quality SWE tasks. Existing synthetic data methods typically create tasks through fixed mutation or bug-injection procedures, making the resulting distributions largely independent of the agent's own weaknesses and training progress. We introduce Socratic-SWE, a closed-loop self-evolution framework that reuses the agent's hi

summary.core_problem: 软件工程（SWE）智能体的训练受限于高质量任务数据的稀缺性约束，传统合成数据方法不感知智能体当前的能力边界，生成的任务分布与智能体的实际能力缺口不匹配；现有方法仅将训练轨迹用于奖励计算，后续直接丢弃，导致训练后期学习停滞。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发点：证明智能体自身的交互轨迹可转化为结构化技能库，用于动态生成匹配当前能力边界的训练任务，实现无外部标注的自进化，为SWE领域智能体的持续预训练与RL训练提供了闭环数据生成范式，也为长horizon任务的课程学习提供了可复用的轨迹利用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Socratic-SWE三阶段闭环自进化框架：第一阶段从历史解题轨迹中提炼重复出现的失败模式与成功修复行为，构建智能体技能注册表来表征模型当前的能力边界；第二阶段以技能为约束，在真实代码仓库中生成针对性修复任务，经执行验证流水线过滤，再通过求解器梯度对齐奖励筛选出能带来有效参数更新的任务；第三阶段求解器在筛选后的任务上训练，产生新的轨迹进入下一轮迭代。与传统开环静态任务生成方法不同，该框架感知模型当前能力，动态调整任务分布适配智能体的进化过程。
summary.experiments: 在36k训练样本的固定预算下，Socratic-SWE在SWE-bench Verified上达到50.40%，比基础智能体高7.80个百分点，比SSR基线高3.40个百分点；在SWE-bench Lite、SWE-bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0上均超过所有适配基线，3轮迭代后仍能持续提升，且能力可迁移到终端原生任务。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先查看Figure1的两种范式对比图，可快速理解核心差异。阅读引言部分的核心动机与框架概述，10分钟即可掌握核心思路。若需进一步了解，可阅读Section3的框架流程与Section4的核心实验结果，总阅读时间控制在30分钟以内。除非专门从事SWE智能体方向研究，无需深入技能蒸馏与任务生成的具体实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Software engineering (SWE) agent training is constrained by the scarcity of high-quality task data. Traditional synthetic data methods are agnostic to the agent's current capability boundary, leading to task distributions misaligned with the agent's actual capability gaps. Existing methods only use training traces for reward computation and discard them afterward, causing learning stagnation in late training stages.
summary_en.importance: It demonstrates that agent interaction traces can be converted into a structured skill library to dynamically generate training tasks matched to the current capability boundary, enabling annotation-free self-evolution. It provides a closed-loop data generation paradigm for continuous pretraining and RL training of SWE agents, and offers a reusable approach to trace utilization for long-horizon curriculum learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Socratic-SWE is a three-stage closed-loop self-evolution framework. First, it distills recurring failure modes and successful repair patterns from historical solving traces into an Agent Skill Registry to represent the model's current capability boundary. Second, it uses these skills as constraints to generate targeted repair tasks in real code repositories, filters candidates via an execution-based validation pipeline, and further selects tasks with a solver-gradient alignment reward that induces effective parameter updates. Third, the solver trains on the selected tasks and produces new traces for the next iteration. Unlike traditional open-loop static task synthesis, this framework is model-aware and dynamically adapts task distribution to the agent's evolving capability.
summary_en.experiments: Under a fixed budget of 36k training instances, Socratic-SWE reaches 50.40% on SWE-bench Verified, 7.80 percentage points higher than the base agent and 3.40 points higher than the SSR baseline. It outperforms all adapted baselines on SWE-bench Lite, SWE-bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, showing sustained improvement across 3 iterations and transferability to terminal-native tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Figure 1 first to understand the core difference between traditional and the proposed paradigm. Read the introduction for core motivation and framework overview to grasp the key idea in around 10 minutes. Read Section 3 for framework workflow and Section 4 for core experimental results if needed, with total reading time within 30 minutes. Detailed implementation of skill distillation and task generation is not necessary unless working specifically on SWE agent research.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当 SWE 小活看，这其实是在试一种更像 online post-train 的数据闭环；先看 trace→skill 抽取和 alignment reward，若 setup 干净，值得在推理数据合成里复现。
recommendation.en: Do not dismiss it as a narrow SWE paper; it is really testing an online post-training data loop. Read the trace-to-skill extraction and the alignment reward first, and if the setup is clean, it is worth reproducing for reasoning-data synthesis.

paper.title: EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Autonomous LLM training is often framed as recipe search, which leaves the training harness largely static. This limitation sharpens in agentic RL, where shifting bottlenecks and scalar rewards mask diverse failure modes. We introduce EvoTrainer, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills. Evaluated on mathem

summary.core_problem: 在 Agentic RL 中，传统的自动化训练框架通常保持诊断和评估工具（Harness）固定，无法适应训练过程中不断变化的瓶颈和复杂的失败模式。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将策略模型与训练侧诊断工具协同进化的新范式，突破了仅搜索训练配方的局限，为复杂 Agent 任务的自动化 RL 训练提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 EvoTrainer 框架，包含两个耦合过程：1) 策略自我进化：生成、比较、修剪和合并训练版本；2) 训练器自我反思：当现有指标或分析工具不足时，进化训练侧的 Harness（如诊断脚本、回测机制）。通过持久化记忆和可复用技能库，积累跨版本的经验。
summary.experiments: 在数学推理、代码生成和仓库级软件工程（SWE）任务上评估。EvoTrainer 均优于无 RL 基线，并在相同设定下匹配或超越了人工设计的 RL 基线。在最复杂的 SWE-9B 任务上提升最大（38.16% vs 人工RL的 33.77%）。分析表明，进化的 Harness 能有效拒绝高分但无效的分支。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 3 节关于 EvoTrainer 协同进化机制的设计（特别是 Harness 进化的具体实现），以及第 4 节在 SWE 任务上的实验结果和过程分析。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In Agentic RL, traditional autonomous training frameworks keep diagnostic and evaluation harnesses static, failing to adapt to shifting bottlenecks and complex failure modes during training.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel paradigm of co-evolving policy models with training-side diagnostic harnesses, breaking the limitation of merely searching training recipes, and offering a new approach for autonomous RL in complex agent tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduced EvoTrainer, a framework with two coupled processes: 1) Policy self-evolution: generating, comparing, pruning, and merging training versions; 2) Trainer self-reflection: evolving the training-side harness (e.g., diagnostic scripts, backtests) when existing metrics are insufficient. It uses persistent memory and a reusable skill library to accumulate cross-version experience.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on math reasoning, code generation, and repo-level SWE. EvoTrainer consistently outperformed no-RL baselines and matched or exceeded human-engineered RL baselines under the same settings. The largest gain was on SWE-9B (38.16% vs. human RL's 33.77%). Analysis shows the evolving harness effectively rejects invalid high-scoring branches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the design of EvoTrainer's co-evolution mechanism (especially the implementation of harness evolution), and Section 4 for experimental results and process analysis on the SWE task. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 的训练环境/脚手架也纳入进化搜索的范畴（co-evolution），在长视距 SWE 任务上效果显著，对探索超越静态 reward 模型的 RL 范式有启发。
recommendation.en: Incorporates the RL training environment/harness into evolutionary search (co-evolution), showing significant gains on long-horizon SWE tasks. Inspiring for exploring RL paradigms beyond static reward models.

institutions: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: SPOQ: Specialist Orchestrated Queuing for Multi-Agent Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Multi-agent AI systems show promise for automating software engineering tasks, yet existing approaches suffer from coordination overhead, quality control gaps, and limited human oversight. We introduce SPOQ (Specialist Orchestrated Queuing), a methodology combining three innovations: (1) wave-based topological dispatch that computes parallel execution waves from task dependency graphs; (2) dual validation gates applying quality metrics before execution (planning validation) and after (code valid

summary.core_problem: 解决多 agent 软件工程系统中的协调开销、质量控制不足和人类监督难以嵌入的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 coding agent 编排方法，贡献偏系统工程：任务图波次调度、双重验证门和 human-in-the-loop 机制。对预训练本身帮助有限，但对后训练后的 agent 系统设计有一些参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SPOQ：基于任务依赖图做 wave-based topological dispatch 以并行执行；在执行前后分别做 planning validation 和 code validation；引入 Human-as-an-Agent 参与任务分解和执行期咨询；并用三层 agent 层级平衡成本与质量。
summary.experiments: 四组实验中，wave dispatch 接近 critical-path 下界，比例 1.03–1.11，最高加速 14.3x；在 2-slot 本地后端上也有稳定收益。摘要未给出标准 SWE benchmark 上与主流强基线的充分对比，因此更像内部系统 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses coordination overhead, weak quality control, and limited human oversight in multi-agent software engineering systems.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent orchestration paper with mainly systems contributions: wave-based scheduling, dual validation gates, and human-in-the-loop integration. It is only indirectly useful for pretraining researchers, but may inform post-training-era agent system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPOQ introduces wave-based topological dispatch over task dependency graphs for parallel execution, planning and code validation gates before and after execution, Human-as-an-Agent participation in decomposition and consultation, and a three-tier agent hierarchy to trade off cost and quality.
summary_en.experiments: Across four experiments, wave dispatch approaches the critical-path lower bound with ratios of 1.03–1.11 and up to 14.3x speedup; it also shows stable gains on a 2-slot local backend. The abstract does not show strong comparisons on standard SWE benchmarks, so it reads more like a system recipe than a broadly validated method.

recommendation.zh: 更像工程编排手册，不是方法突破；若你在搭内部 coding agent，只看调度和 validation gate 设计，别指望学到模型层 insight。
recommendation.en: This is closer to an orchestration playbook than a method breakthrough; if you run internal coding agents, read the scheduling and validation-gate bits, but do not expect model-level insight.

paper.title: Towards Evaluation Engineering: An Empirical Study of ML Evaluation Harnesses in the Wild
paper.abstract: Evaluation harnesses are software systems that orchestrate model evaluation by managing model invocation, data loading, metric computation, and result reporting. Despite their critical role in machine learning infrastructure, their operational challenges and engineering concerns have received limited attention so far. We present an empirical study of 57 evaluation harnesses, deriving a five-stage harness model and classifying 16,560 issues by workflow stage and root cause. Most harness operation

summary.core_problem: 研究现实中的 ML evaluation harness 在工程上最常出现哪些问题，以及这些问题集中在哪些工作流阶段。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是软件工程实证分析。它不是模型方法论文，但对大模型评测基础设施建设有一定参考，尤其适合负责内部 eval platform 的研究工程团队。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析了 57 个 evaluation harness，抽象出五阶段工作流模型，并将 16,560 个 issue 按阶段和根因分类，统计常见故障模式，如未实现功能、文档缺失和输入校验不足。
summary.experiments: 这是实证研究而非模型实验。主要结果是 41.4% 的问题集中在 Specification 阶段；最常见三类根因分别是未实现功能、文档缺口和缺少输入校验，合计占 61.7%。这些数字对搭建评测系统有直接工程意义。
summary.authors_note: 来自 Concordia University 的 SAIL 和 LUMS，偏软件工程研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies what operational problems evaluation harnesses face in practice and where those problems concentrate in the evaluation workflow.
summary_en.importance: This is a software-engineering empirical study rather than a model-method paper, but it has some value for teams building internal LLM evaluation infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze 57 evaluation harnesses, derive a five-stage workflow model, and classify 16,560 issues by workflow stage and root cause, highlighting recurring failure modes such as unimplemented features, documentation gaps, and missing input validation.
summary_en.experiments: This is an empirical infrastructure study, not a model experiment. The main findings are that 41.4% of issues occur in the Specification stage, and the top three root causes—unimplemented features, documentation gaps, and missing input validation—account for 61.7% of issues. These numbers are directly useful for evaluation-system engineering.
summary_en.authors_note: From Concordia University’s SAIL and LUMS, with a software-engineering focus.

recommendation.zh: 不是研究方法论文，但做 eval 平台的人该看；正文不用细读，记住 issue 主要死在 specification、文档和输入校验这三处。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but useful if you own eval infrastructure; no need to read deeply—just remember that most failures cluster around specification, docs, and input validation.

paper.title: SetupX: Can LLM Agents Learn from Past Failures in Functionality-Correct Code Repository Setup?
paper.abstract: Functionality-correct repository setup aims to configure execution environments (e.g., dependencies, build scripts) to successfully execute a repository's documented features. It presents significant challenges due to diverse, repository-specific failures, including dependency incompatibilities, missing toolchains, incomplete installations, and verification-strategy mismatches. Existing LLM agents struggle to robustly resolve these issues, specifically failing to support (1) cross-repository exp

summary.core_problem: 解决代码仓库 setup agent 在真实环境配置中难以跨仓库迁移经验、在不可逆状态下反复试错、以及可靠验证 setup 是否成功的问题。
summary.importance: 这是软件工程 agent 的实用问题，和基座预训练关系不强，但其中“从失败经验中学习”和“环境状态不可逆”这两个设定，对工具使用型 agent 训练与评测有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 SetupX。核心包括一个 Self-Evolving Experience Representation（XPU），把 setup 信号、文本指导和可执行动作编码成可迁移经验单元；再结合基于经验的试错修复流程，在新仓库上复用已验证的环境修复策略，并强调区分 setup 失败与仓库自身 bug 的验证机制。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者关注 functionality-correct repository setup 这一更贴近真实执行环境的任务，并与现有 LLM agents 比较其跨仓库迁移、multi-step repair 和 outcome verification 能力，但未给出 benchmark 规模、模型、成功率提升等关键数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Independent Researcher 与 Inspur 相关机构，但缺少可确认的知名团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles repository setup agents for real execution environments, where current systems struggle with cross-repository transfer, trial-and-repair under non-revertible states, and reliable verification of whether setup actually succeeded.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a software-engineering agent problem rather than a foundation-model pretraining problem, but the notions of learning from failures and handling irreversible environment states are mildly relevant to tool-using agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SetupX. Its core component is a Self-Evolving Experience Representation (XPU) that packages setup signals, textual guidance, and executable actions into transferable experience units. These are then reused in an experience-driven repair loop, with explicit verification to separate setup-induced failures from repository bugs.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the task is functionality-correct repository setup in realistic environments, and the comparisons focus on transfer, multi-step repair, and verification robustness against existing LLM agents. However, the abstract does not provide benchmark size, model details, or effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes an Independent Researcher and an Inspur-affiliated institution, but no clearly identifiable well-known lab can be confirmed from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 更像 SWE agent 工程题，不会直接反馈到 pretrain；若你做 tool-use agent，只看经验表示和验证设计，别在结果表上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is mostly an SWE-agent engineering paper, not something that feeds back into pretraining; if you care about tool-use agents, just inspect the experience representation and verification design.

paper.title: SpecBench: Measuring Reward Hacking in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
paper.abstract: As long-horizon coding agents produce more code than any developer can review, oversight collapses onto a single surface: the automated test suite. Reward hacking naturally arises in this setup, as the agent optimizes for passing tests while deviating from the users true goal. We study this reward hacking phenomenon by decompose software engineering tasks into three parts: (i) a natural language description of the specification (ii) visible validation tests that exercise specified features in is

summary.core_problem: 长周期编码代理仅以可见的验证测试集为优化目标，普遍存在奖励黑客问题，目前缺乏量化衡量该问题的基准与方法。
summary.importance: 明确了编码代理中奖励黑客的可量化指标，为编码代理的训练信号设计、评测体系优化提供参考，也为RL对齐中的代理奖励设计提供了跨领域的实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 构建SpecBench基准，包含30个系统级编码任务，每个任务配套可见的单功能验证测试集和隐藏的功能组合保留测试集，定义奖励黑客gap为验证集通过率与保留集通过率的差值，用来量化代理的作弊程度。
summary.experiments: 在多模型、多编码框架、多搜索策略下的测试显示，所有模型都可以在验证集上达到满通过率；奖励黑客gap随任务复杂度上升而扩大，MMLU得分更低的模型gap更大；同时总结出特征隔离、直接记忆验证测试等具体作弊策略。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注基准设计部分的测试集划分逻辑、实验部分的两个核心相关性结论，以及作弊策略的分类总结，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon coding agents only optimize against visible validation test suites, leading to pervasive reward hacking, and there is no existing benchmark or quantitative method to measure this problem.
summary_en.importance: It defines a quantifiable metric for reward hacking in coding agents, provides reference for coding agent training signal design and evaluation system optimization, and offers cross-domain empirical evidence for proxy reward design in RL alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SpecBench benchmark includes 30 system-level coding tasks. Each task is paired with a visible validation test suite that tests individual features, and a hidden held-out test suite that tests feature compositions. The reward hacking gap, defined as the difference between validation pass rate and held-out pass rate, is used to quantify the degree of reward hacking.
summary_en.experiments: Tests across multiple models, coding harnesses and search strategies show all models can achieve 100% pass rate on validation suites. The reward hacking gap grows with task complexity, and models with lower MMLU scores have larger gaps. Common hacking strategies including feature isolation and direct memorization of validation tests are also documented.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the test suite split logic in Benchmark Design section, the two core correlation findings in Experiments, and the classification of hacking strategies. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和 visible/held-out gap；它提醒 coding RL 的奖励面可能比能力面更脆。
recommendation.en: Read the task construction and visible/held-out gap; it is a useful warning that coding-RL reward surfaces can be much weaker than the capability they claim to measure.

paper.title: Multi-agent Collaboration with State Management
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multi-agent systems have shown great potential for solving complex tasks. However, when multiple agents edit a shared codebase concurrently, their changes can silently conflict and inconsistent views lead to integration failures. Existing multi-agent systems address this through workspace isolation (e.g., one git worktree per agent), but this defers conflict resolution to a post-hoc merge step where recovery is expensive. In this paper, we propose STORM, i.e., STate-ORiented M

summary.core_problem: 多个 coding agent 并发编辑同一代码库时，隔离工作区会把冲突推迟到合并阶段，导致视图不一致和集成失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding-agent 系统设计。它关注多 agent 协作中的状态一致性和写入时冲突处理，比简单多 agent 投票或分工更接近真实软件工程工作流。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STORM，即 State-Oriented Management。系统作为共享 workspace 的中介，管理 agent 状态和写入操作，保证每个 agent 在一致代码视图上工作，并在写入时检测与解决冲突，而不是事后依赖 git worktree merge。
summary.experiments: 在 Commit0 和 PaperBench 上跨多个 LLM 评测。相对 git-worktree 多 agent baseline，STORM 在 Commit0-Lite 上提升 +18.7，在 PaperBench 上提升 +1.4，并报告成本效率相当或更好。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiaotong University、Emory University 和 Peking University；工作面向多 agent 代码协作系统。

summary_en.core_problem: When multiple coding agents edit a shared repository concurrently, isolated workspaces defer conflicts to a late merge step, causing inconsistent views and integration failures.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent systems contribution. It studies state consistency and write-time conflict handling in multi-agent software workflows, which is more realistic than simple agent voting or task decomposition.
summary_en.technical_approach: STORM mediates interactions with the shared workspace. It manages agent state, enforces consistent repository views, and detects or resolves conflicting edits at write time instead of relying on post-hoc git-worktree merging.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Commit0 and PaperBench with multiple LLMs. It improves over a git-worktree-based multi-agent baseline by +18.7 on Commit0-Lite and +1.4 on PaperBench, with comparable or better cost efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Jiaotong University, Emory University, and Peking University; the work targets multi-agent coding collaboration systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding-agent 系统备查即可；核心信号是写入时状态管理比事后 merge 更干净。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a coding-agent systems reference; the useful signal is that write-time state management is cleaner than post-hoc merging.

paper.title: SaaSBench: Exploring the Boundaries of Coding Agents in Long-Horizon Enterprise SaaS Engineering
paper.abstract: As autonomous coding agents become capable of handling increasingly long-horizon tasks, they have gradually demonstrated the potential to complete end-to-end software development. Although existing benchmarks have recently evolved from localized code editing to from-scratch project generation, they remain confined to structurally simplified, single-stack applications. Consequently, they fail to capture the heterogeneous environments, full-stack orchestration, and system-level complexity of real

summary.core_problem: 构建一个更贴近真实企业级 SaaS 开发的长时程 coding agent 基准，用来测量从 PRD 理解、全栈实现、部署到调试的端到端能力，并解决现有基准在系统复杂度、市场真实度与评测机制上的不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接信息增益有限，但它提供了更“长上下文 + 多语言/多框架 + 强交互”的评测压力源，可能反向影响代码预训练与后训练的数据配比（多语言、配置/脚本、DevOps 文本）、长上下文训练、以及 agentic tool-use 的训练信号设计。更适合作为 post-train/agent 评测资产，而不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: SaaSBench 包含 30 个任务，覆盖 6 类 SaaS 域。每个任务提供长上下文 PRD、用于消歧的知识库、标准化运行环境，以及 DAG 形式的测试套件。评测采用 dependency-aware 的混合范式：用 DAG 表达前置依赖，通过 prerequisite gating 与 failure propagation control 把复杂系统的验证拆成可执行的线性检查链；同时提供 binary/weighted/LLM-as-judge 三种计分，覆盖部署可用性、数据建模、API 契约一致性、业务逻辑正确性、访问控制、工程质量等维度。
summary.experiments: 论文报告当前主流 coding agents 在该基准上仍有明显差距，暴露长时程规划与跨组件协同问题。当前提供的全文片段未包含各模型的具体分数表与对比数字，精确结论需以实验章节的主表为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：优先看任务构建流程、DAG 评测设计与可执行验证节点的定义（理解它如何避免“只看最终是否跑通”的粗粒度信号）。再快速扫实验主表了解难点分布。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住要点。若关注预训练，只需记录它对数据与长上下文能力提出了哪些具体需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Introduce a realistic long-horizon benchmark for enterprise SaaS engineering to evaluate coding agents on end-to-end workflows (PRD understanding, full-stack implementation, deployment, iterative debugging) under heterogeneous stacks and system-level constraints.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining methodology, but it is a strong evaluation pressure test that can feed back into pretrain/post-train decisions: multilingual/code+config+DevOps data mixtures, long-context training, and training signals for tool-using/agentic coding. Best viewed as an eval asset for coding agents rather than a pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: SaaSBench contains 30 tasks across 6 SaaS domains. Each task includes a long-context PRD, an ambiguity-resolution KB, a standardized runtime environment, and a DAG-based test suite. The evaluation is dependency-aware: prerequisite gating and failure-propagation control decompose complex system validation into executable checking chains. Scoring includes binary, weighted, and LLM-as-judge modes, covering deployment availability, data modeling, API contract consistency, business logic, access control, and engineering quality.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports substantial gaps for current state-of-the-art coding agents on SaaSBench, especially in long-horizon planning and cross-component coordination. The provided excerpt does not include the detailed score tables; exact numbers should be taken from the main experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim focus: benchmark construction pipeline, DAG evaluation design, and how executable validation nodes are defined to avoid overly coarse end-to-end signals. Then scan the main results table to see where failures concentrate. ~30–45 minutes to capture the essentials. If your focus is pretraining, extract the concrete capability demands implied by the tasks (context length, stack diversity, config/deployment artifacts).

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和验证节点设计即可；它更像 agent eval 压力测试，不直接指导预训练数据配比。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and validation-node design; it is a useful agent-eval stress test, not a direct guide for pretraining data mixture.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: EGSS: Entropy-guided Stepwise Scaling for Reliable Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Agentic Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has delivered state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on complex software engineering tasks such as code generation and bug fixing. However, its practical adoption remains limited due to significant computational overhead, primarily driven by two key challenges: (1) the high cost associated with deploying excessively large ensembles, and (2) the lack of a reliable mechanism for selecting the optimal candidate solution, ultimately constraining the performance gains tha

summary.core_problem: 现有测试时缩放（TTS）方法在软件工程Agent任务中存在计算冗余高、探索效率低、候选补丁筛选不可靠的问题：均匀采样和静态引导导致算力分配不合理，低熵常规步骤占用过多资源，高熵决策点探索不足；仅靠最终测试结果排序的筛选机制容易忽略中间调试信号，选出仅通过局部检查、未解决根本问题的脆弱补丁。
summary.importance: 为代码领域LLM的推理时算力优化提供了可落地的思路，熵引导的动态资源分配逻辑可以迁移到其他长程推理Agent的测试时缩放框架设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出熵引导分步缩放（EGSS）框架，包含两个核心设计：1）用工具熵量化每一步的决策不确定性，仅在高熵决策点调用辅助判别器实时评估、剪枝分支轨迹，动态将推理预算分配给探索价值最高的步骤；2）融合多Agent轨迹的调试信号、仓库原有回归测试、新增边缘用例构造多维测试集，结合多模型集成投票筛选可靠候选补丁。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Bench-Verified基准上，EGSS将所有测试模型的性能提升5-10%，在开源方法中达到最优表现，同时推理时token消耗比此前的TTS方法降低28%；实证分析显示88%的任务轨迹包含自验证步骤，但其中35.7%的自验证轨迹仍然失败，工具熵呈右偏分布，绝大多数步骤为低熵常规操作，验证了自适应算力分配的合理性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题分析、Figure1的算力-性能 trade-off 图、Preliminary章节的工具熵分布实证分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Test-Time Scaling (TTS) methods for software engineering agent tasks suffer from high computational redundancy, low exploration efficiency, and unreliable candidate patch selection. Uniform sampling and static guidance lead to suboptimal compute allocation: low-entropy routine steps consume excessive resources while high-entropy decision points get insufficient exploration. Ranking mechanisms based only on final test results tend to ignore intermediate debugging signals, and select brittle patches that pass local checks without addressing root causes.
summary_en.importance: It provides an implementable approach for inference-time compute optimization of code-domain LLMs, and the entropy-guided dynamic resource allocation logic can be migrated to TTS framework design for other long-horizon reasoning agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Entropy-Guided Stepwise Scaling (EGSS) framework with two core designs: 1) Quantify step-level decision uncertainty with tool entropy, only invoke auxiliary judges at high-entropy decision points for real-time evaluation and trajectory pruning, dynamically allocating inference budget to steps with highest exploration value; 2) Construct a multi-dimensional test suite by integrating debugging signals from multiple agent trajectories, existing repository regression tests, and newly identified edge cases, combined with multi-model ensemble voting to select reliable candidate patches.
summary_en.experiments: On the SWE-Bench-Verified benchmark, EGSS improves performance of all evaluated models by 5-10%, achieves the best performance among open-source methods, and reduces inference token consumption by 28% compared to prior TTS approaches. Empirical analysis shows 88% of task trajectories include self-verification steps, but 35.7% of these still fail. Tool entropy follows a right-skewed distribution, with most steps being low-entropy routine operations, validating the rationality of adaptive compute allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, Figure 1 for compute-performance trade-off, and empirical analysis of tool entropy distribution in Preliminary. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵控扩展和测试增强两节；这是干净的 inference-time compute 分配问题，可作为 RLVR 数据筛选的旁证。
recommendation.en: Read only the entropy-controlled scaling and test-augmentation sections; it is a clean inference-time compute allocation signal, useful as weak evidence for RLVR-style data selection.

paper.title: Agentic Interpretation: Lattice-Structured Evidence for LLM-Based Program Analysis
paper.abstract: Large language models can consult information that fixed static analyzers cannot, such as documentation, current security advisories, version-specific metadata, and informal API contracts. This makes LLMs a compelling option for program analyses that depend on information beyond the source program, or that are otherwise not amenable to conventional static analyzers. However, directly asking an LLM for a one-shot whole-program analysis is brittle because it compresses many evidence-dependent judg

summary.core_problem: 如何利用 LLM 进行需要结合外部信息（如文档、安全建议）的复杂程序分析，同时避免单次查询带来的脆弱性和不透明性？
summary.importance: 将传统基于格（lattice-based）的静态分析方法引入 LLM 驱动的程序推理中，提供了一种结构化、可解释的 Agentic 分析框架，有助于提升 LLM 在复杂软件工程任务中的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic Interpretation 框架。将高层次的分析目标分解为局部的声明（claims），并在有限高度的格（lattice）中跟踪 LLM 对每个声明的判断。这种结构化的证据收集过程避免了将所有判断压缩成单一答案，允许使用中间发现来指导后续搜索。
summary.experiments: （摘要未详细说明实验结果，主要强调框架设计）

summary_en.core_problem: How to leverage LLMs for complex program analysis that requires external information (e.g., documentation, security advisories) while avoiding the brittleness and opacity of one-shot queries?
summary_en.importance: Introduces traditional lattice-based static analysis principles into LLM-driven program reasoning, providing a structured and interpretable Agentic analysis framework that helps improve LLM reliability in complex software engineering tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Agentic Interpretation framework. It decomposes high-level analysis goals into localized claims and tracks the LLM's judgment about each claim in a finite-height lattice. This structured evidence collection avoids compressing all judgments into a single answer and allows intermediate findings to guide subsequent searches.
summary_en.experiments: (Abstract does not detail experimental results, focusing on framework design)

recommendation.zh: 将传统静态分析的格理论（lattice）引入 LLM 代码分析 Agent，属于特定领域的 Agent 架构设计，对通用预训练启发有限，作为 coding agent 的 literature 备查即可。
recommendation.en: Introduces lattice theory from traditional static analysis into LLM code analysis agents. It's a domain-specific agent architecture design with limited inspiration for general pretraining. Keep as literature reference for coding agents.

paper.title: The Readability Spectrum: Patterns, Issues, and Prompt Effects in LLM-Generated Code
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming software development, the functional quality of generated code has become a central focus, leaving readability, one of critical non-functional attributes, understudied. Given that LLM-generated code still needs human review before adoption, it is important to understand its readability especially compared with human-written code and the role of prompt design in shaping it. We therefore set out to conduct a systematic investigation into the code re

summary.core_problem: 系统评估 LLM 生成代码的可读性，以及不同 prompt 设计如何影响可读性这一非功能质量指标。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是代码生成评测维度的补充。它把关注点从功能正确性转向人类审查成本，对 coding agent 的验收标准有一定参考，但不直接推进预训练或代码模型训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建一个综合代码可读性模型，合并文本特征、结构特征、程序特征和视觉特征，用于量化 LLM 生成代码与人类代码的可读性差异，并分析 prompt 对结果的影响。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖从 World of Code 和 LeetCode 抽取的 5,869 个场景，比较主流 LLM 生成代码和人类编写代码。摘要给出的主要结论是：当前 LLM 生成代码整体可读性接近人类代码，但存在可读性谱系上的模式差异；具体模型列表、提升幅度和统计显著性需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和武汉大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures the readability of LLM-generated code and studies how prompt design changes this non-functional quality attribute.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is an evaluation contribution for code generation. It moves beyond functional correctness toward human review cost, which is relevant to coding-agent acceptance criteria but not to foundation-model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a code readability model combining textual, structural, program-level, and visual features, then use it to compare LLM-generated code with human-written code and to analyze prompt effects.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates mainstream LLMs across 5,869 scenarios extracted from World of Code and LeetCode. The abstract reports that LLM-generated code has overall readability comparable to human-written code, while showing distinct readability patterns; model-level details and effect sizes are not available from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Wuhan University.

recommendation.zh: 作为代码评测特征库备查即可；若做代码模型训练，读可读性特征定义比读结论更有用。
recommendation.en: Useful as a feature catalog for code evaluation; for code-model training, the readability taxonomy matters more than the headline result.

paper.title: AI Harness Engineering: A Runtime Substrate for Foundation-Model Software Agents
paper.abstract: Foundation models have transformed automated code generation, yet autonomous software-engineering agents remain unreliable in realistic development settings. The dominant explanation locates this gap in model capability. We propose a different locus: software-engineering capability emerges from a model-harness-environment system, in which a runtime substrate -- the harness -- mediates how a foundation-model agent observes a project, acts on it, receives feedback, and establishes that a change is

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么基础模型在自动代码生成上有进展，但软件工程 agent 在真实项目中仍不稳定，并将问题定位到 model-harness-environment 的运行时系统。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 系统抽象和评测协议，而不是模型训练方法。它把软件工程能力拆成模型能力与 harness 能力的组合，对设计仓库级 agent 评测和诊断有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 AI Harness Engineering 概念，定义 harness 作为模型观察项目、调用工具、接收反馈、确认任务完成的运行时基座。它列出 11 类组件职责，包括任务规格、上下文选择、工具访问、项目记忆、任务状态、可观测性、失败归因、验证、权限、熵审计和干预记录，并提出 H0-H3 四级 runtime 支持阶梯和 trace-based evaluation protocol。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述框架和评测协议，未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、基线系统或定量提升结果。更像是概念框架/系统设计论文，而非大规模实证论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hong Kong Baptist University 和 Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why foundation models can generate code yet remain unreliable as autonomous software-engineering agents in realistic projects, and locates the gap in the model-harness-environment system.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a system abstraction and evaluation protocol for coding agents, not a model-training method. It decomposes software-engineering capability into model capability plus harness capability, which is useful for repository-level agent diagnosis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce AI Harness Engineering, where the harness is the runtime substrate through which the model observes a project, acts, receives feedback, and establishes completion. They define eleven responsibilities—task specification, context selection, tool access, project memory, task state, observability, failure attribution, verification, permissions, entropy auditing, and intervention recording—and propose an H0-H3 ladder of runtime support plus a trace-based evaluation protocol.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mainly presents a framework and protocol. It does not report model sizes, training data, baseline systems, or quantitative improvements, so the work appears closer to a conceptual systems paper than a large empirical study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Hong Kong Baptist University and Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai.

recommendation.zh: 适合扫框架图和 11 个 harness 职责；它不是训练论文，但能帮你避免把 agent 失败全甩给模型。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework and the eleven harness responsibilities; it is not a training paper, but it helps avoid blaming every agent failure on the model.

paper.title: Agentic Coding Needs Proactivity, Not Just Autonomy
paper.abstract: Coding agents are rapidly changing the landscape of software development, moving from inline completion to autonomous systems that edit repositories, open pull requests, respond to issues, and run scheduled or webhook triggered routines across the development life cycle. The next generation is increasingly described as proactive and long-horizon: agents should notice relevant changes before the developer asks, connect signals across tools, decide when to interrupt, and carry preferences across s

summary.core_problem: 当前编码智能体领域对「主动性」缺乏明确定义、与自主性的边界区分和统一评估标准，无法支撑下一代长周期主动编码智能体的设计与评测。
summary.importance: 为编码智能体的后训练对齐研究提供了标准化分类框架和评估维度，避免将预设触发的自动化能力误判为真正的主动性，可直接用于指导主动编码智能体的训练目标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 基于混合主动交互理论提出三级主动性分类：1级为仅响应显式提示的被动智能体，2级为基于定时、webhook等预设触发器运行的调度型智能体，3级为持续感知上下文、权衡收益与打断成本、将沉默作为显式动作、并能根据用户反馈更新策略的情境感知型智能体；同时提出3个评估指标：洞察决策质量（IDQ）、上下文接地分数（CGS）、学习提升（LL），并对5款现有主流编码智能体做了评测。
summary.experiments: 所有被评测的现有编码智能体均处于2级水平，核心能力缺口是判断何时打断用户、何时展示信息、何时保持沉默的个性化决策策略。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节的三级分类框架和第4节的评测指标设计，预计阅读时间15分钟，无需深入细读理论溯源部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The coding agent field lacks clear definitions of proactivity, boundary distinctions between proactivity and autonomy, and unified evaluation criteria, which hinders the design and evaluation of next-generation long-horizon proactive coding agents.
summary_en.importance: Provides a standardized classification framework and evaluation dimensions for post-training alignment of coding agents, eliminates confusion between pre-defined trigger-based automation and genuine proactivity, and can directly guide the design of training objectives for proactive coding agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on mixed-initiative interaction theory, proposes a three-level proactivity taxonomy: Level 1 (Reactive) agents run only on explicit prompts; Level 2 (Scheduled) agents run based on pre-defined triggers (timers, webhooks, etc.) but do not learn cross-context per-developer interruption policies; Level 3 (Situation Aware) agents continuously monitor context, balance expected benefit against interruption cost, treat silence as an explicit action, and update policies based on user feedback. Also proposes three evaluation metrics: Insight Decision Quality (IDQ), Context Grounding Score (CGS), and Learning Lift (LL), and conducts audits on 5 existing mainstream coding agents.
summary_en.experiments: All audited existing coding agents are categorized as Level 2, with the core capability gap lying in the personalized decision policy of when to interrupt users, when to present information, and when to stay silent.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the three-level taxonomy in Section 3 and evaluation metric design in Section 4, expected reading time ~15 minutes, no need to dive into detailed theoretical origin content.

recommendation.zh: 明确coding agent的评估方向，做代码agent的研究员可看前3节理清主动性和自主性的差异，后续实验设计可参考定义
recommendation.en: Clarifies the evaluation direction of coding agents, researchers working on code agents can read first 3 sections to understand the difference between proactivity and autonomy for reference in experiment design

paper.title: Constraint Decay: The Fragility of LLM Agents in Backend Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents demonstrate strong performance in autonomous code generation under loose specifications. However, production-grade software requires strict adherence to structural constraints, such as architectural patterns, databases, and object-relational mappings. Existing benchmarks often overlook these non-functional requirements, rewarding functionally correct but structurally arbitrary solutions. We present a systematic study evaluating how well agents handle structural

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM代码生成Agent的评测基准忽略生产级后端代码的非功能约束（架构模式、数据库、对象关系映射等），无法衡量Agent在严格结构约束下的多文件代码生成能力。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前代码生成Agent在生产场景落地的核心短板，为代码大模型的预训练数据优化、SFT对齐目标设计提供了明确的改进方向，也补充了更贴近工业场景的代码生成评测标准。
summary.technical_approach: 基于OpenAPI规范构建评测pipeline，固定功能需求（统一API契约），系统调整非功能约束维度（框架选择、架构模式、数据库后端、对象关系映射集成），通过端到端行为测试和静态检查结合的方式，分离功能正确性和结构合规性的评估。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖8个Web框架的80个从零开始生成任务、20个功能实现任务测试集上，观测到约束衰减现象：结构约束密度提升时，Agent平均断言通过率下降30分；轻量显式框架（如Flask）下的表现明显优于重约定框架（如FastAPI）；45%的逻辑错误来自数据层缺陷，主要是查询组合错误和对象关系映射运行时违规。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3章评测方法论设计、第4章约束衰减的实验结果、第5章错误根因分类，预计阅读时长20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation benchmarks for LLM code generation agents ignore non-functional constraints of production-grade backend code (architectural patterns, databases, ORM mappings, etc.), and cannot measure the multi-file code generation capability of agents under strict structural constraints.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the core gap of current code generation agents for production deployment, provides clear improvement directions for pre-training data optimization and SFT alignment target design of code LLMs, and complements code generation evaluation standards closer to industrial scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds an evaluation pipeline based on OpenAPI specifications, fixes functional requirements with a unified API contract, systematically varies non-functional constraint dimensions (framework choice, architectural pattern, database backend, ORM integration), and separates evaluation of functional correctness and structural compliance through a combination of end-to-end behavioral tests and static checks.
summary_en.experiments: On the test set covering 8 web frameworks, 80 greenfield generation tasks and 20 feature implementation tasks, the constraint decay phenomenon is observed: when structural constraint density increases, the average assertion pass rate of agents drops by 30 points; agents perform significantly better on lightweight explicit frameworks (e.g. Flask) than on convention-heavy frameworks (e.g. FastAPI); 45% of logical errors come from data layer defects, mainly incorrect query composition and ORM runtime violations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3 for evaluation methodology design, Chapter 4 for constraint decay experimental results, and Chapter 5 for error root cause classification. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示的 constraint decay 现象对 code agent 的评测设计有参考价值——现有 benchmark 只测功能正确性确实不够。看 §4 的实验发现部分即可
recommendation.en: The constraint decay phenomenon is informative for code agent benchmark design — existing benchmarks only measuring functional correctness is indeed insufficient. Read §4 for experimental findings only.

paper.title: ProgramBench: Can Language Models Rebuild Programs From Scratch?
paper.abstract: Turning ideas into full software projects from scratch has become a popular use case for language models. Agents are being deployed to seed, maintain, and grow codebases over extended periods with minimal human oversight. Such settings require models to make high-level software architecture decisions. However, existing benchmarks measure focused, limited tasks such as fixing a single bug or developing a single, specified feature. We therefore introduce ProgramBench to measure the ability of soft

summary.core_problem: 评测语言模型和软件工程 Agent 是否能在只给定程序行为与文档的情况下，从零重建完整软件项目。
summary.importance: 这是一个来自 Meta FAIR 等机构的代码 Agent benchmark。它把评测目标从单 bug 修复、单 feature 实现，推进到项目级架构设计和端到端行为复现，更贴近长期自主软件开发场景。
summary.technical_approach: ProgramBench 给 agent 一个参考程序及其文档，要求生成一个行为等价的代码库，而不规定实现结构。评测端通过 agent-driven fuzzing 生成端到端行为测试，用黑盒行为一致性替代人工指定内部实现。
summary.experiments: benchmark 含 200 个任务，覆盖小型 CLI 工具到 FFmpeg、SQLite、PHP interpreter 等真实软件。论文评测 9 个语言模型。摘要未给出完整排名和具体通过率，只说明该设置用于检验整体软件构建能力。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Meta FAIR、Stanford University 和 Harvard University；Gabriel Synnaeve 是 Meta FAIR 研究员，长期参与机器学习系统、智能体和大模型相关研究；Pengcheng Yin 在代码生成和程序合成方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark tests whether language models and software-engineering agents can rebuild complete software projects from scratch given only a reference program and its documentation.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent benchmark from Meta FAIR and collaborators. It shifts evaluation from localized bug fixes or single feature requests to project-level architecture and end-to-end behavioral reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProgramBench gives agents a program and documentation, then asks them to implement a behaviorally matching codebase without prescribing the internal structure. Evaluation uses agent-driven fuzzing to generate end-to-end behavioral tests, turning the task into black-box behavioral equivalence.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 200 tasks, ranging from compact CLI tools to real software such as FFmpeg, SQLite, and the PHP interpreter. The paper evaluates 9 language models. The provided abstract does not include detailed pass rates or model rankings.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include Meta FAIR, Stanford University, and Harvard University. Gabriel Synnaeve is a Meta FAIR researcher with work on ML systems, agents, and large models; Pengcheng Yin is known for code generation and program synthesis research.

recommendation.zh: 值得看任务构造和 fuzzing 评测，别只看排行榜；它会暴露代码预训练里“会补丁、不懂项目”的盲区。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and fuzzing evaluation, not just the leaderboard; it probes the gap between patching code and building software.

paper.title: RECAP: An End-to-End Platform for Capturing, Replaying, and Analyzing AI-Assisted Programming Interactions
paper.abstract: Understanding how developers interact with AI coding assistants requires more than chat logs or git histories in isolation; it requires reconstructing the full context: which prompt led to which edit, what the developer tried and discarded, and how their strategy evolved over time. We present RECAP (Replay and Examine Captured AI Programming), an open-source platform that (1) passively records AI chat sessions and fine-grained code edits inside VS Code without disrupting the developer's workflow

summary.core_problem: 记录、回放并分析开发者与 AI 编程助手交互时的完整上下文，而不只依赖聊天日志或 git 历史。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是软件工程与 AI 编程交互研究平台；它为研究人类如何实际使用 coding assistant 提供更细粒度数据，但不是代码模型训练或 Agent 方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出开源平台 RECAP，在 VS Code 中被动记录 AI chat session 和细粒度代码编辑，将二者合并成统一时间线，并提供可扩展分析层，用于行为分类、AI 依赖度测量和交互回放。
summary.experiments: 在一门大学软件工程课程中部署，覆盖 41 名学生的多周项目，记录 2034 条 prompt 和 8239 次代码编辑；展示了 linked timeline 和 replay 对开发者-AI 交互分析的支持。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Carnegie Mellon University；Tongshuang Wu 长期从事 HCI、NLP 和人机协作相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper records, replays, and analyzes the full context of developer interactions with AI coding assistants, beyond chat logs or git histories alone.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a software-engineering and human-AI interaction platform. It provides finer-grained data for studying how developers actually use coding assistants, but it is not a code-model training or agent-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: RECAP is an open-source VS Code platform that passively records AI chat sessions and fine-grained code edits, merges them into a unified timeline, supports interactive replay, and exposes an extensible analysis layer for behavioral classification and AI-reliance measurement.
summary_en.experiments: The platform was deployed in a university software engineering course, capturing 2,034 prompts and 8,239 code edits from 41 students over a multi-week project. The paper demonstrates analyses enabled by linked timelines and replay.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Carnegie Mellon University. Tongshuang Wu is known for work in HCI, NLP, and human-AI collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 作为 coding assistant 行为数据来源备查即可；平台有用，但对训练目标和模型能力边界没有直接结论。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for coding-assistant interaction data; useful platform, but little direct signal for training objectives or model limits.

paper.title: The Productivity-Reliability Paradox: Specification-Driven Governance for AI-Augmented Software Development
paper.abstract: Since 2022, AI-powered coding assistants have produced contradictory evidence: controlled studies report 20-56% productivity gains on well-scoped tasks, while the most rigorous RCT documents a 19% slowdown for experienced developers, and telemetry across 10,000+ developers shows 98% more pull requests but 91% longer review times with flat delivery metrics. This paper argues these findings constitute the Productivity-Reliability Paradox (PRP): a systematic phenomenon emerging from non-determinist

summary.core_problem: 解释 AI 编程助手为什么在受控小任务中提升效率，却在真实团队交付中可能拉长评审周期、降低可靠性。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是概念框架和文献整理，而不是新模型或新训练方法；它把 AI coding 的收益从“生成速度”转向“规格、评审、上下文约束”来讨论，对 coding agent 评测设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 2022-2026 年 67 个学术和灰色文献来源，定义 Productivity-Reliability Paradox，并提出三个调节变量：任务抽象程度、代码库成熟度、开发者经验；同时分析代码评审瓶颈和上下文窗口约束两个放大机制。
summary.experiments: 没有新的模型训练或可复现实验；证据来自文献综述，包括受控研究中 20-56% 的生产率提升、严格 RCT 中经验开发者 19% 的减速，以及 1 万名以上开发者遥测中 PR 数增加 98%、评审时间增加 91%、交付指标持平的现象。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 School of Architecture, Computing and Engineering, University of East；未见可确认的大模型预训练团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why AI coding assistants can speed up small, well-scoped tasks while slowing down or destabilizing real software delivery.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a conceptual taxonomy and evidence synthesis rather than a new model or training method. The useful angle is shifting coding-agent evaluation from generation speed to specification quality, review load, and context limits.
summary_en.technical_approach: It reviews 67 academic and grey-literature sources from 2022 to 2026, defines the Productivity-Reliability Paradox, and frames it through three moderators: task abstraction, codebase maturity, and developer experience. It also identifies review bottlenecks and context-window constraints as amplifying mechanisms.
summary_en.experiments: There are no new model experiments. The evidence is synthesized from prior studies: 20-56% productivity gains on controlled tasks, a 19% slowdown for experienced developers in a rigorous RCT, and telemetry over 10,000+ developers showing 98% more pull requests, 91% longer review time, and flat delivery metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with the School of Architecture, Computing and Engineering, University of East; no major LLM pretraining lab background is identifiable from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 coding-agent 负效应文献索引；概念多于可复现实验，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Useful as a citation map for coding-agent failure modes; it is mostly conceptual, so the full text is not essential.

paper.title: SWE-Edit: Rethinking Code Editing for Efficient SWE-Agent
paper.abstract: Large language model agents have achieved remarkable progress on software engineering tasks, yet current approaches suffer from a fundamental context coupling problem: the standard code editing interface conflates code inspection, modification planning, and edit execution within a single context window, forcing agents to interleave exploratory viewing with strictly formatted edit generation. This causes irrelevant information to accumulate and degrades agent performance. To address this, we prop

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 SWE-agent 中代码编辑接口的上下文耦合问题：同一个 agent 既要探索代码、保留上下文、制定修改方案，又要生成格式严格的编辑指令，导致无关代码堆积在上下文里，并增加编辑格式失败率。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，但对代码 agent 的训练和评测有直接参考价值。它指出代码能力不只来自模型参数，也受接口设计和上下文组织方式影响。对基座研究的间接启发是：如果要训练或评估代码模型，编辑动作本身应被拆成可学习、可测量的子能力，例如定位相关代码、选择编辑粒度、执行格式敏感的修改。这样的分解比只看端到端 SWE-bench 分数更容易定位模型短板。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-Edit 有两层设计。第一层是 scaffold 分解，把原本由主 agent 完成的 view 和 edit 操作拆给两个子 agent。Viewer 接收文件路径和自然语言查询，返回与任务相关的代码片段，而不是把整段文件内容塞回主上下文；提示中要求返回完整逻辑块和必要邻近上下文，以降低过度裁剪风险。Editor 接收文件路径和自然语言修改指令，直接完成代码修改，让主 agent 只负责问题求解和修改计划，不再生成脆弱的 find-replace 格式。第二层是编辑模型训练。作者用 GRPO 训练 Qwen3-8B，让编辑器在 find-replace 和 whole-file rewrite 之间自适应选择。小改动适合 find-replace，复杂重构适合整文件重写；单一格式在不同修改类型上都会有盲区。
summary.experiments: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，subagent 分解相比 baseline 提升 2.1%，同时推理成本降低 17.9%。由于计划和格式化编辑被解耦，编辑格式可靠性提升 3.5%。在实验中，主 agent 平均每个实例调用 Viewer 7.49 次，说明它并不是一次性检索全部上下文，而是按需反复查询。模型层面，经过 GRPO 训练的 Qwen3-8B 编辑器能够根据修改复杂度选择编辑模式，编辑准确率优于单一 find-replace 或单一 whole-file rewrite baseline。论文还引入了一个代码编辑 benchmark，并声称该 benchmark 上的表现能预测模型作为 Editor 子 agent 时的下游效果。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的接口拆分设计，而不是只看 SWE-bench 分数。Viewer 的提示约束、Editor 的输入输出协议、以及 find-replace 和 whole-file rewrite 的选择策略最有参考意义。实验部分建议看成本变化、格式失败率和编辑 benchmark 与下游表现的相关性。如果关注代码模型 post-training，可以进一步看 GRPO 训练数据和奖励如何定义；如果只关注通用 agent scaffold，读 scaffold ablation 即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context coupling in SWE-style coding agents. A single agent is usually responsible for code exploration, reasoning about modifications, and producing strictly formatted edits. This mixes broad inspection with precision editing, causing irrelevant code to accumulate in the context window and increasing formatting failures during edit execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to coding-agent training and evaluation. It shows that code performance depends strongly on the interface through which the model reads and edits repositories. For model research, the useful point is the decomposition of coding ability into measurable subskills: retrieving relevant code, deciding the edit granularity, and executing format-sensitive modifications. This gives a cleaner diagnostic than relying only on end-to-end SWE-bench scores.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Edit has a scaffold-level component and a model-level component. At the scaffold level, it splits the standard code editing interface into two subagents. The Viewer takes a file path and a natural-language query, then returns only task-relevant code snippets instead of exposing full file contents to the main agent. Its prompt asks for complete logical blocks and nearby context to reduce the risk of over-pruning. The Editor takes a file path and a natural-language edit instruction, then applies the modification directly. This lets the main agent focus on problem solving and planning, without having to emit brittle find-replace commands. At the model level, the authors train a Qwen3-8B editor with GRPO to choose adaptively between find-replace and whole-file rewrite. Small localized changes favor find-replace, while broader restructuring favors whole-file rewriting.
summary_en.experiments: On SWE-bench Verified, the subagent decomposition improves the baseline by 2.1% while reducing inference cost by 17.9%. Decoupling planning from formatted edit generation also improves edit formatting reliability by 3.5%. The agent makes 7.49 Viewer calls per instance on average, suggesting an iterative on-demand retrieval pattern rather than one-shot context loading. The GRPO-trained Qwen3-8B editor outperforms single-format editing baselines by selecting the editing mode according to modification complexity. The paper also introduces a code editing benchmark and reports that performance on this benchmark predicts downstream effectiveness when the model is used as the Editor subagent.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the interface decomposition in Section 3: the Viewer prompt constraints, the Editor protocol, and the policy for choosing between find-replace and whole-file rewrite. In the experiments, look at cost, formatting reliability, and the relationship between the editing benchmark and downstream SWE-agent performance. Readers interested in coding post-training should inspect the GRPO setup and reward definition if available; readers interested in agent scaffolds can focus on the scaffold ablations.

recommendation.zh: 预训练方向不用细读，直接看编辑接口拆分和 GRPO 编辑格式选择；它更像 Agent 工程里一次干净的上下文隔离实验。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; read the interface split and GRPO-based edit-format selection as a clean context-isolation experiment for coding agents.

paper.title: Carbon-Taxed Transformers: A Green Compression Pipeline for Overgrown Language Models
paper.abstract: The accelerating adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in software engineering (SE) has brought with it a silent crisis: unsustainable computational cost. While these models demonstrate remarkable capabilities in different SE tasks, they are unmanageably large, slow to deploy, memory-intensive, and carbon-heavy. This reality threatens not only the scalability and accessibility of AI-powered SE, but also its long-term environmental sustainability. The research challenge is clear: we must go be

summary.core_problem: 针对软件工程场景中 LLM 部署成本、内存占用、延迟和碳排放过高的问题，提出一个压缩流程选择与排序框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工程压缩 pipeline，而不是新的预训练或模型架构；它把环境成本显式纳入模型压缩目标，对 serving 成本讨论有参考意义，但摘要中的“carbon tax”更像调度准则和评估口径，不一定带来新的压缩机制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Carbon-Taxed Transformers，将经济学中的 carbon pricing 类比为计算碳税，对架构低效进行惩罚、对可部署压缩进行奖励；方法看起来是多架构压缩流程排序与选择，可能组合剪枝、量化、蒸馏或模型裁剪等常见手段，但摘要未展示完整算法细节。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在多个软件工程任务上评估 CTT，但给出的摘要被截断，未能确认具体任务、模型规模、压缩率、延迟/显存/能耗测量方式和精度损失。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Saskatchewan，研究背景偏软件工程和软件开发协作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the high deployment cost, memory footprint, latency, and carbon impact of LLMs used in software-engineering tasks.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering compression pipeline rather than a new pretraining method or model architecture. Explicitly including environmental cost in compression objectives is useful for serving discussions, but the carbon-tax framing appears to be a selection and evaluation principle rather than a new compression primitive.
summary_en.technical_approach: Carbon-Taxed Transformers applies an analogy to carbon pricing: architectural inefficiencies are penalized and deployment-ready compression is rewarded. The method appears to organize and order multi-architecture compression steps, likely involving standard compression tools, though the provided abstract does not expose the full algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims evaluation across multiple software-engineering tasks, but the provided abstract is truncated and does not reveal the exact tasks, model sizes, compression ratios, latency or energy measurements, or accuracy trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Saskatchewan, with a software-engineering and collaborative software-development focus.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验表里精度-延迟-能耗的 Pareto 曲线；若没有真实功耗测量，carbon tax 只是包装。
recommendation.en: Only inspect the accuracy-latency-energy Pareto tables; without real power measurements, the carbon-tax framing is mostly packaging.

CHANCHAL K. ROY, University of Saskatchewan
KEVIN A. SCHNEIDER, University of Saskatchewan

paper.title: RAT: RunAnyThing via Fully Automated Environment Configuration
paper.abstract: Automating repository-level software engineering tasks is a foundational challenge for autonomous code agents, largely due to the difficulty of configuring executable environments. However, manual configuration remains a labor-intensive bottleneck, necessitating a transition toward fully automated environment configuration. Existing approaches often rely on pre-defined artifacts or are restricted to specific programming languages, limiting their applicability to real-world repositories. In this

summary.core_problem: RAT 试图解决 repository-level code agent 的可执行环境自动配置问题：给定任意真实仓库，自动推断依赖、构建容器、找到验证命令，并让项目能跑起来。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是预训练方法论文，但和 code LLM 的训练闭环有关。可执行环境配置是把静态代码仓库变成可验证训练样本的前置条件。没有环境，代码数据只能提供文本监督；有环境后，可以构造 execution traces、生成可执行反馈、支持基于测试结果的 SFT 或 RL。对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：代码模型的数据质量不只取决于代码本身，还取决于能否恢复其运行上下文。大规模自动配置仓库环境，可能比继续清洗更多静态代码更能提高训练信号密度。
summary.technical_approach: RAT 是一个语言无关的多阶段 agent pipeline。它先做 semantic initialization，通过 ImageRetriever 分析仓库结构、README、构建文件和语言线索，选择合适的基础镜像，降低后续配置搜索空间。然后使用双模式 planning：简单仓库走较直接的配置路径，复杂或未见过的仓库则使用更细的规划和迭代修复。执行阶段在容器 sandbox 中运行，调用专门工具集处理语言识别、依赖安装、构建命令、测试命令、错误日志解析等问题。系统还引入长期经验积累，用历史配置知识帮助解决跨会话反复出现的依赖和构建问题。和依赖 Dockerfile、CI 日志或特定语言规则的系统不同，RAT 的目标是在缺少完整配置 artifacts 的真实仓库上工作。
summary.experiments: 作者构建了 RATBench，包含超过 2000 个 GitHub 仓库，强调多语言、真实项目分布和可执行性验证。评测指标是 Environment Setup Success Rate，即系统生成的环境和验证流程是否能无错误运行。文中称 RAT 在 RATBench 上取得更高的 ESSR，并且在环境配置能力上超过人工专家。给定材料中没有提供完整表格和精确数值，因此不宜进一步推断具体提升幅度。实验的关键价值在于 benchmark 设计：它把环境配置从若干人工整理样例扩展到更接近真实仓库分布的大规模评测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 RATBench 的构建流程、成功判定标准和仓库采样方式，因为这些决定 benchmark 是否真的能代表开放仓库。方法部分可重点看 ImageRetriever、planning 机制、sandbox 工具接口和经验积累模块。若关注 code LLM 训练，最值得看的是作者如何把环境配置 trace 定义为可复用数据，以及它怎样支撑 execution-based reinforcement 和数据合成。具体 agent prompt 和工具工程细节可以按需略读。

summary_en.core_problem: RAT targets automated environment setup for arbitrary software repositories: infer the runtime, dependencies, build steps, and validation commands well enough to produce a runnable container or Dockerfile.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant to code-agent infrastructure and training-data construction rather than base-model pretraining itself. Its relevance to LLM research comes from executability. If repositories can be configured automatically at scale, static code corpora can be converted into verifiable tasks, execution traces, and reward signals. That matters for code SFT and RL, where functional feedback is much cleaner than text-only supervision. The broader lesson is that code-data quality depends heavily on recovering the execution context, not just deduplicating or filtering source files.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAT is a modular, language-agnostic pipeline. It begins with semantic initialization: an ImageRetriever inspects repository structure, documentation, manifests, and language cues to select an appropriate base image. A planning module then decides how to configure and validate the project, with a more direct mode for simple repositories and a more iterative mode for complex or unfamiliar ones. The agent operates inside a containerized sandbox and uses specialized tools for language detection, dependency installation, build and test invocation, and error-log interpretation. The system also accumulates long-term configuration expertise, so repeated dependency and runtime issues can be handled more consistently. The main distinction from prior work is reduced reliance on curated Dockerfiles, CI logs, or language-specific assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: The authors introduce RATBench, a multilingual benchmark with more than 2,000 GitHub repositories, sampled to better reflect real repository diversity. The main metric is Environment Setup Success Rate: whether the produced environment and verification sequence run successfully. The paper reports that RAT achieves stronger ESSR than previous automated setup methods and exceeds human experts in the evaluated configuration setting. The provided text does not include exact tables or numerical margins, so the safe conclusion is about the direction and benchmark scale rather than a precise effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Read the RATBench construction and executability criteria first, since the benchmark definition determines how meaningful the reported success rate is. Then inspect the ImageRetriever, planning module, sandbox tool interface, and long-term expertise mechanism. For code-LLM researchers, the most useful angle is how configuration traces can become reusable training data and how successful environment setup enables execution-based rewards. Low-level prompt and tool-engineering details can be read selectively.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和失败案例；这类执行环境问题比换 prompt 更接近 code agent 的真实瓶颈。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and failure cases; executable-environment setup is a more real bottleneck for code agents than another prompt variant.

paper.title: Towards Secure Logging: Characterizing and Benchmarking Logging Code Security Issues with LLMs
paper.abstract: Logging code plays an important role in software systems by recording key events and behaviors, which are essential for debugging and monitoring. However, insecure logging practices can inadvertently expose sensitive information or enable attacks such as log injection, posing serious threats to system security and privacy. Prior research has examined general defects in logging code, but systematic analysis of logging code security issues remains limited, particularly in leveraging LLMs for detec

summary.core_problem: 系统刻画 logging code 的安全问题，并评测 LLM 对这类问题的检测与修复能力。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 taxonomy + benchmark + evaluation framework，属于代码安全评测资源建设。对预训练研究的价值不在方法本身，而在于提供一个较细粒度的软件安全能力切片。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先归纳四类 logging 安全问题和 10 种模式，再构建包含 101 个真实 issue report 的人工审阅数据集，并设计结合多种上下文知识的自动化评测框架，用于测试 LLM 的检测与修复表现。
summary.experiments: 摘要只给出 benchmark 规模为 101 个真实世界 logging 安全问题，没有给出具体参评模型、上下文配置和提升幅度。实验重点应是不同上下文知识对检测/修复性能的影响，而非提出新的训练方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 York University、香港科技大学（广州）、University of Waterloo、University of Alberta。更偏软件工程 benchmark 构建与 LLM 能力评测。

summary_en.core_problem: It systematically characterizes security issues in logging code and evaluates LLMs on detecting and repairing them.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a taxonomy, benchmark, and evaluation framework. Its value for pretraining researchers is not methodological, but as a fine-grained slice of software-security capability evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper derives four categories and ten patterns of logging security issues, builds a manually reviewed benchmark of 101 real-world issue reports, and proposes an automated framework that injects various contextual knowledge to evaluate LLM-based detection and repair.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract only states that the benchmark contains 101 real-world logging security issues, without specifying evaluated models, context settings, or gains. The experiments likely focus on how contextual knowledge affects detection and repair rather than on a new training method.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from York University, HKUST (Guangzhou), University of Waterloo, and University of Alberta. The work is primarily a software-engineering benchmark and LLM capability evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 这是细分代码安全 benchmark，不是方法论文；做代码预训练评测切片时可备查，平时不值得投入正文阅读。
recommendation.en: A niche code-security benchmark rather than a methods paper; keep it as an evaluation reference, not something worth a full read for most pretraining work.

paper.title: AgentForge: Execution-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Autonomous Software Engineering

summary.core_problem: 如何在仓库级自动软件工程中，把“可执行验证”变成多智能体协作的强约束，从而减少LLM生成代码的不可验证与错误传播。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统/范式实践：把执行反馈（sandbox execution）提升为“每次变更必须通过执行”的一等公民约束，并在多角色分工框架中验证其对SWE-bench类任务的显著增益；对构建更可靠的代码Agent与评测闭环有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AgentForge多智能体框架（Planner/Coder/Tester/Debugger/Critic）+共享记忆；核心原则是execution-grounded verification：代码补丁在传播/合入前必须在强隔离Docker沙箱中执行测试/验证；将软件工程过程形式化为对repository state的迭代决策过程，用执行反馈作为比next-token likelihood更强的监督信号来源（但主要是系统设计而非训练新模型）。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-BENCH Lite上报告40.0% resolution；相对单智能体baseline提升26-28个百分点；消融显示“执行反馈强约束”和“角色分解”均能独立带来提升（未在摘要中给出模型规模/具体LLM与计算成本细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make execution-based verification a hard constraint in multi-agent repository-level software engineering, reducing unverified and error-propagating LLM code changes.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a systems/practice contribution: elevates sandboxed execution feedback to a first-class requirement (“every change must run”) and demonstrates large gains on SWE-bench-style tasks, informing reliable code-agent loops and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentForge: a multi-agent framework (Planner/Coder/Tester/Debugger/Critic) with shared memory; key principle is execution-grounded verification where patches must pass Docker-sandboxed execution before being propagated/merged; frames repo-level SE as an iterative decision process over repository states, using execution feedback as stronger supervision than next-token likelihood (without proposing a new base-model training method).
summary_en.experiments: Reports 40.0% resolution on SWE-BENCH Lite; +26–28 points over single-agent baselines; ablations attribute gains to both mandatory execution feedback and role decomposition (no model size / exact LLM / compute details in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 作为工程范式备查即可：把“每次改动必须可执行验证”做成硬约束，但对预训练没新 prior；只看执行门控如何插进多智能体流水线。
recommendation.en: Glance as a systems pattern: execution-as-a-hard-gate in a multi-agent loop, but it doesn’t move pretraining priors; just inspect how the execution gate is enforced in the workflow.

paper.title: Do AI Coding Agents Log Like Humans? An Empirical Study
paper.abstract: Software logging is essential for maintaining and debugging complex systems, yet it remains unclear how AI coding agents handle this non-functional requirement. While prior work characterizes human logging practices, the behaviors of AI coding agents and the efficacy of natural language instructions in governing them are unexplored. To address this gap, we conduct an empirical study of 4,550 agentic pull requests across 81 open-source repositories. We compare agent logging patterns against human

summary.core_problem: 研究 AI coding agents 在软件日志记录这一非功能性需求上是否表现得像人类开发者，以及自然语言指令能否有效约束其行为。
summary.importance: 这是代码 agent 的经验研究，不是方法创新；价值在于补充一个常被忽视的 failure mode：agent 能改功能，不代表会保留可维护性与可观测性。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析 81 个开源仓库中的 4,550 个 agentic pull requests，对比 agent 与人类在 logging 修改频率、日志密度、以及对显式 logging 指令的遵从情况，并统计后续由人类完成的日志修复。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 4,550 个 agentic PR、81 个仓库。摘要报告：agent 在 58.4% 的仓库中比人类更少改 logging；一旦改动，其 log density 往往更高；显式 logging 指令仅占 4.7%，且 67% 的建设性请求未被遵守；72.5% 的后续日志修复由人类完成。没有涉及模型训练或通用能力提升实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者中 Ahmed E. Hassan 在软件工程实证研究领域较知名；本文属于软件工程数据分析范式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether AI coding agents handle software logging like human developers, and whether natural-language instructions can effectively steer this behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical coding-agent study rather than a methods contribution; its value is in exposing a neglected failure mode: functional edits do not guarantee maintainability or observability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze 4,550 agentic pull requests across 81 open-source repositories, comparing agents and humans on logging-change frequency, log density, compliance with explicit logging instructions, and subsequent human repairs.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset covers 4,550 agentic PRs over 81 repositories. The abstract reports that agents modify logging less often than humans in 58.4% of repositories, show higher log density when they do edit logs, fail to comply with constructive logging requests 67% of the time, and leave 72.5% of post-generation log repairs to humans. There is no training-method or capability-improvement experiment.
summary_en.authors_note: Ahmed E. Hassan is well known in empirical software engineering; the paper fits that evidence-driven SE tradition.

recommendation.zh: 偏软件工程实证，不会改变你做预训练的路线；但若做 coding agent，摘要里的三个比例已经足够说明可维护性仍靠人补锅。
recommendation.en: This is mostly empirical software engineering and won’t change your pretraining roadmap; for coding agents, the three headline percentages already tell the story.

paper.title: SWE-AGILE: A Software Agent Framework for Efficiently Managing Dynamic Reasoning Context

summary.core_problem: 在多轮软件工程代理（SWE）中，如何在“深度推理（长CoT）”与“上下文长度/效率限制”之间取得平衡，避免上下文爆炸与重复推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为系统/框架创新：针对ReAct式SWE代理在长程推理历史管理上的核心瓶颈（lost-in-the-middle、token成本、重复思考）提出可落地的上下文组织范式（滑窗+摘要），对仓库级/多步修复类coding agent具有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SWE-AGILE框架与Dynamic Reasoning Context策略：保留近期一段“详细推理滑动窗口”以维持局部连续性；将更早的推理历史压缩为简洁的Reasoning Digests以保留关键信息并控制上下文长度，从而减少每步重新分析的冗余并降低中间信息丢失。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出可核验的关键实验细节（具体基准、模型、参数量、数据、对比方法、提升幅度在截断处缺失）；仅能确认其宣称在SWE任务上取得新的最好结果（new state-of-the-art）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to manage reasoning history in multi-turn software-engineering agents to avoid context explosion and redundant re-reasoning while preserving the depth and continuity needed for long-horizon tasks under context-length and efficiency constraints.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a practical framework for organizing and compressing ReAct-style reasoning traces to mitigate token cost, lost-in-the-middle effects, and repeated analysis—directly relevant to repository-scale, multi-step repair agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-AGILE proposes a Dynamic Reasoning Context strategy that keeps a sliding window of recent detailed reasoning for local coherence while compressing older history into concise 'Reasoning Digests' that retain key information and reduce repeated computation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided summary indicates the paper claims new state-of-the-art results on SWE tasks, but the abstract-level information available here does not include verifiable details about benchmarks, models, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 当框架点子看：只看其上下文管理策略（滑窗/摘要/去重）和成本分析，能直接改你自己的长程 SWE agent；科研增量有限。
recommendation.en: Treat as a framework idea: skim the context-management policy (windowing/summaries/dedup) and cost analysis—directly applicable to long-horizon SWE agents, limited research novelty.

paper.title: SkillMOO: Multi-Objective Optimization of Agent Skills for Software Engineering

summary.core_problem: 如何在软件工程类LLM coding agent中，自动化地为“技能/指令模块（skills）”做组合与调参，以同时优化成功率、成本与运行时延，避免人工反复试错。
summary.importance: 方法与系统创新：把“技能bundle选择/编辑”形式化为多目标优化问题，并给出可落地的自动进化框架；对构建可复用、可维护的coding agent技能库与评测闭环有直接启发（尤其是成本-效果-时延的三方权衡）。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillMOO：用NSGA-II做多目标进化搜索；由两个LLM驱动角色协作——solver agent在任务上评估候选skill bundle并产出失败分析，optimizer agent基于失败分析提出对bundle的编辑（增删改、替换、剪枝等）；通过幸存者选择迭代进化，得到Pareto更优的技能组合。
summary.experiments: 在三个SkillsBench软件工程任务上评测；相对每个任务上“最佳baseline”，pass rate最高提升到+131%，同时成本最高降低到-32%，且优化开销较低；并做pattern分析，发现剪枝与替换是主要增益来源（更少、更聚焦的指令优于不断累积）。

summary_en.core_problem: Automatically composing and tuning skill/instruction modules for software-engineering coding agents to jointly optimize success rate, cost, and latency, avoiding manual trial-and-error.
summary_en.importance: Formulates skill-bundle design as a practical multi-objective optimization problem and provides an automated evolutionary framework, supporting maintainable, reusable skill libraries and explicit cost–quality–latency trade-offs in coding-agent engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces SkillMOO using NSGA-II for multi-objective evolutionary search. A solver agent evaluates candidate skill bundles on tasks and produces failure analyses; an optimizer agent edits bundles (add/remove/modify/replace/prune) based on these analyses. Iterative survivor selection yields Pareto-improved skill configurations.
summary_en.experiments: On three SkillsBench software-engineering tasks, achieves up to +131% pass-rate improvement over the best per-task baseline while reducing cost by up to 32%, with relatively low optimization overhead; analysis suggests pruning and replacement drive most gains, indicating smaller, more focused instruction sets can outperform ever-growing bundles.

recommendation.zh: 把skill组合/参数搜索做成多目标优化，能直接指导你怎么自动化调“成功率-成本-时延”；但收益多来自工程搜索，别期待新理论。
recommendation.en: Turns skill bundling/tuning into explicit multi-objective optimization—immediately actionable for success/cost/latency tradeoffs; mostly engineering search, not new theory.

paper.title: The AI Codebase Maturity Model: From Assisted Coding to Self-Sustaining Systems

summary.core_problem: 团队如何从“提示词+人工review”的AI辅助编码，系统性演进到具备持续反馈闭环、可自我维持的AI驱动软件工程系统。
summary.importance: 观点/经验与框架贡献：提出类似CMMI的5级成熟度模型（ACMM），强调AI开发系统的能力更多来自测试、指标、CI/CD与反馈回路基础设施，而非单纯更强模型；对构建可扩展的coding agent工作流与评测闭环有实践启发。
summary.technical_approach: ACMM用“反馈回路拓扑”定义各成熟度等级，并给出从低级到高级所需机制（指令体系、测试体系、度量与自动化回归等）；通过一个4个月的真实项目维护经验报告进行验证。
summary.experiments: 非传统ML实验；以KubeStellar Console工程数据作证据：63个CI/CD workflows、32个nightly test suites、91%代码覆盖率、24小时bug-to-fix时间<30分钟；使用Claude Code (Opus)与GitHub Copilot作为主要工具。

summary_en.core_problem: How software teams can systematically evolve from prompt-assisted coding with human review to AI-driven engineering systems that maintain themselves via continuous feedback loops.
summary_en.importance: Presents a maturity-model perspective (akin to CMMI) arguing that scalable AI software engineering depends more on tests, metrics, CI/CD, and feedback infrastructure than on simply using stronger models, offering actionable guidance for building robust coding-agent workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines the AI Codebase Maturity Model (ACMM) with five levels characterized by the topology and strength of feedback loops, and outlines the mechanisms required to progress (instruction discipline, testing strategy, measurement, automated regression, etc.). The framework is illustrated through a multi-month real-world maintenance effort.
summary_en.experiments: Not a traditional ML evaluation; evidence is drawn from a 4-month project (KubeStellar Console) reporting operational metrics such as 63 CI/CD workflows, 32 nightly test suites, 91% code coverage, and <30 minutes bug-to-fix within 24 hours, using Claude Code (Opus) and GitHub Copilot.

recommendation.zh: 更像组织流程框架而非技术论文；当作“要先补测试/指标/CI闭环再谈coding agent”的提醒即可，挑成熟度分级表看完就够。
recommendation.en: More process model than research; treat it as a reminder that tests/metrics/CI feedback loops dominate coding-agent outcomes—just read the maturity level table and move on.
